When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.
fr: Pokemon Hypnose
Quand il remue son nez, il devine ou sont les personnes endormies et de quoi elles revent.
de: Hypnose
Wenn es mit seiner grossen Nase zuckt, kann es feststellen, wo jemand schlaeft und was er gerade traeumt.
it: Pokemon Ipnosi
Quando fiuta con il suo grande naso, riesce a localizzare chi dorme e a capire che sogni sta facendo.
pt: Hypnosis Pokemon
When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

es: Pokemon Hipnosis
Lleva siempre un pendulo que hace oscilar a un ritmo constante y con el que causa sueno a quien se acerque.
en: Hypnosis Pokemon
Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.
fr: Pokemon Hypnose
Il tient toujours un pendule qui va et vient de facon reguliere et peut endormir tout etre aux alentours.
de: Hypnose
Es haelt immer ein Pendel, welches es in einem gleichmaessigen Rhythmus bewegt. Dies verursacht bei jedem in seiner Naehe Muedigkeit.
it: Pokemon Ipnosi
Ha sempre con se un pendolo che agita a ritmo regolare. Fa assopire chiunque gli si avvicini.
pt: Hypnosis Pokemon
Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

es: Pokemon Cangrejo
Vive en madrigueras excavadas en playas arenosas. Sus pinzas vuelven a crecer si se desprenden.
en: River Crab Pokemon
It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are lost in battle.
fr: Pokemon Doux Crabe
Il creuse des trous dans le sable des plages ou il vit. Ses pinces repoussent a l'identique si elles se detachent lors d'un combat.
de: Krabben-Pokemon
Es lebt in Loechern, die es am Strand in den Sand graebt. Seine Scheren wachsen vollstaendig nach, wenn es sie im Kampf verliert.
it: Pokemon Granchio
Vive in buche scavate nelle spiagge sabbiose. Le sue chele ricrescono se si spezzano durante la lotta.
pt: River Crab Pokemon
It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are lost in battle.

es: Pokemon Tenaza
La pinza mayor posee una fuerza devastadora, pero es tan pesada que le cuesta usarla con precision.
en: Pincer Pokemon
The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
fr: Pokemon Pince
Sa grande pince possede une puissance incommensurable, mais son poids la rend difficile a manier.
de: Kneifer-Pokemon
Seine groessere Schere verfuegt zwar ueber eine ausserordentliche Staerke, aber durch ihr immenses Gewicht ist sie nur schwer zu handhaben.
it: Pokemon Chela
La chela piu grande e estremamente forte, ma e cosi pesante che non permette di mirare bene.
pt: Pincer Pokemon
The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

es: Pokemon Bola
Suele vivir en centrales de energia. Mucha gente acaba muy mal al confundirlo con una Poke Ball.
en: Ball Pokemon
It's usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poke Ball, it has zapped many people.
fr: Pokemon Balle
On le trouve dans des centrales electriques. De nombreuses personnes ont recu une decharge apres l'avoir confondu avec une Poke Ball.
de: Ball
Viele Menschen verwechseln Voltobal mit einem Pokeball und erhalten beim Anfassen einen Stromschlag. Es lebt vorwiegend in Kraftwerken.
it: Pokemon Ball
Solitamente si aggira nelle centrali elettriche e luoghi simili. Molti lo confondono con una Poke Ball, finendo folgorati.
pt: Ball Pokemon
It's usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poke Ball, it has zapped many people.

es: Pokemon Bola
Como explotan a la minima, se les tiene mucho miedo. Reciben el mote de Bomba Ball.
en: Ball Pokemon
It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball.
fr: Pokemon Balle
Il explose au moindre choc. Son surnom, Bombe Ball , suffit a effrayer ses adversaires.
de: Ball
Es explodiert schon bei kleinsten Reizen und ist unter dem Spitznamen Bombenkugel" gefuerchtet.
it: Pokemon Ball
Puo esplodere al minimo urto. Temuto da tutti, e conosciuto con il nomignolo di "Bomba Ball".
pt: Ball Pokemon
It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball.

es: Pokemon Huevo
Utilizan entre ellos un tipo de telepatia que solo pueden entender los Exeggcute para mantenerse siempre en grupos de seis cabezas.
en: Egg Pokemon
Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.
fr: Pokemon OEuf
En utilisant un pouvoir telepathique que seuls les Noeunoeuf percoivent, ses six tetes peuvent rester groupees en toutes circonstances.
de: Ei-Pokemon
Die Koepfe nutzen untereinander Telepathie, die nur sie wahrnehmen koennen, um stets eine Gruppe von sechs Exemplaren zu bilden.
it: Pokemon Uovo
Usando un richiamo telepatico percepito solo dai suoi simili, riesce in qualsiasi momento a formare un gruppo di sei individui.
pt: Egg Pokemon
Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

es: Pokemon Coco
Se dice que, en muy raras ocasiones, una de sus cabezas cae al suelo y comienza a desplazarse convertida en Exeggcute.
en: Coconut Pokemon
It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.
fr: Pokemon Fruitpalme
On raconte qu'en de tres rares occasions, une de ses tetes tombe au sol et devient un Noeunoeuf.
de: Palmfrucht-Pokemon
Es heisst, in sehr seltenen Faellen falle einer seiner Koepfe zu Boden und lebe als Owei weiter.
it: Pokemon Nocecocco
Si dice che, in rare occasioni, una delle sue teste cada al suolo e cominci a muoversi, diventando un Exeggcute.
pt: Coconut Pokemon
It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

es: Pokemon Solitario
El llanto que emite cuando se acuerda de su madre fallecida resuena en el craneo que lleva en la cabeza.
en: Lonely Pokemon
When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
fr: Pokemon Solitaire
On entend le crane qu'il porte sur sa tete cliqueter lorsqu'il sanglote en pensant a sa mere defunte.
de: Einsam-Pokemon
Denkt es an seine verstorbene Mutter, bricht es in Traenen aus. Sein Wehklagen laesst den Schaedel, den es auf dem Kopf traegt, klappern.
it: Pokemon Solitario
Quando piange pensando alla madre defunta, dal teschio che ha in testa proviene un rumore sordo e continuo.
pt: Lonely Pokemon
When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

es: Pokemon Apilahueso
Este Pokemon de caracter salvaje porta desde que nace un hueso que utiliza con maestria.
en: Bone Keeper Pokemon
The bones it uses have been in its possession since it was born. It has a ferocious nature.
fr: Pokemon Gard'Os
Ce Pokemon au temperament violent manie avec dexterite l'os qu'il tient depuis sa naissance.
de: Knochenfan-Pokemon
Von Geburt an fuehrt dieses wilde Pokemon einen Knochen mit sich, den es geschickt einzusetzen weiss.
it: Pokemon Guardaossi
Ha un carattere aggressivo e sa usare abilmente l'osso che tiene in mano sin dalla nascita.
pt: Bone Keeper Pokemon
The bones it uses have been in its possession since it was born. It has a ferocious nature.

es: Pokemon Patada
Es capaz de estirar y contraer los ligamentos de las piernas a su antojo. Cuando propina una patada, llega a doblar su alcance.
en: Kicking Pokemon
It has complete control over the ligaments in its legs, expanding and contracting them to double the reach of its kicks.
fr: Pokemon Latteur
Il peut etirer et retracter les ligaments de ses jambes a volonte, ce qui lui permet de doubler la portee de ses coups de pied.
de: Kicker-Pokemon
Es kann die Baender in seinen Beinen nach Belieben dehnen und zusammenziehen, wodurch sich die Reichweite seiner Tritte verdoppelt.
it: Pokemon Tiracalci
Puo allungare o accorciare i legamenti delle gambe a piacere, raddoppiando cosi la portata dei suoi calci.
pt: Kicking Pokemon
It has complete control over the ligaments in its legs, expanding and contracting them to double the reach of its kicks.

es: Pokemon Punetazo
Sus punos son un manojo de puro musculo. Cada tres minutos se toma un descanso para respirar y recuperar la concentracion.
en: Punching Pokemon
Its fists are masses of muscle. It takes a break every three minutes to steady its breath and mood.
fr: Pokemon Puncheur
Ses poings sont des boules de muscles. Toutes les trois minutes, il fait une pause pour reprendre son souffle et retrouver sa concentration.
de: Puncher-Pokemon
Seine Faeuste bestehen aus reiner Muskelmasse. Alle drei Minuten muss es kurz Pause machen, um Luft zu schnappen und sich zu sammeln.
it: Pokemon Tirapugni
I suoi pugni sono un concentrato di muscoli. Ogni tre minuti fa una pausa per riprendere fiato e ritrovare la calma.
pt: Punching Pokemon
Its fists are masses of muscle. It takes a break every three minutes to steady its breath and mood.

es: Pokemon Lametazo
Usa su larga lengua con destreza, como si de una mano se tratase. Al hervir su untuosa saliva, se obtiene un pegamento muy potente con multitud de usos.
en: Licking Pokemon
Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokemon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.
fr: Pokemon Lecheur
Il utilise sa langue aussi aisement que nous nous servons de nos mains. En faisant bouillir sa salive visqueuse, on peut fabriquer une glu fort utile.
de: Schlecker-Pokemon
Es kann seine lange Zunge so geschickt einsetzen, als waere sie ein Arm. Kocht man den klebrigen Speichel ein, erhaelt man einen vielseitig verwendbaren, starken Leim.
it: Pokemon Linguaccia
Adopra con destrezza la lingua bislunga alla stregua di una mano. La viscosa saliva, se bollita, si converte in un efficace e utile collante.
pt: Licking Pokemon
Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokemon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

es: Pokemon Gas Venenoso
Los gases venenosos que contiene son ligeramente menos pesados que el aire, por lo que siempre flota levemente.
en: Poison Gas Pokemon
The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air. That's why it's always slightly airborne.
fr: Pokemon Gaz Mortel
Les gaz toxiques qu'il contient sont un peu plus legers que l'air et le maintiennent en levitation.
de: Giftwolken-Pokemon
Das giftige Gas in seinem Inneren ist etwas leichter als Luft. Dadurch schwebt es stets in geringer Hoehe.
it: Pokemon Velenuvola
I gas velenosi che contiene sono di poco piu leggeri dell'aria, percio resta sollevato da terra.
pt: Poison Gas Pokemon
The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air. That's why it's always slightly airborne.

es: Pokemon Gas Venenoso
Conforme inhala los gases toxicos que se desprenden de la basura, se va hinchando y el mal olor de su interior empeora.
en: Poison Gas Pokemon
When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.
fr: Pokemon Gaz Mortel
Chaque fois qu'il aspire des gaz toxiques emanant de dechets, son corps gonfle et ses entrailles sentent encore plus mauvais.
de: Giftwolken-Pokemon
Atmet es giftige Gase von Abfaellen ein, blaeht es sich auf und sein Inneres riecht noch schlimmer.
it: Pokemon Velenuvola
Quando inspira gas velenosi dai rifiuti, il suo corpo si gonfia e diventa sempre piu maleodorante all'interno.
pt: Poison Gas Pokemon
When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.

es: Pokemon Clavos
Cuando empieza a correr, no se detiene ni al chocarse contra una roca, por lo que el habitat de esta especie no hace mas que expandirse.
en: Spikes Pokemon
Once it starts running, it won't stop-even if it crashes through boulders. This disposition is what's caused its habitat to expand.
fr: Pokemon Piquant
Par nature, il ne s'arrete jamais de courir une fois lance, meme s'il percute des rochers. C'est ainsi que son habitat s'est progressivement agrandi.
de: Stachler-Pokemon
Wenn es losstuermt, koennen selbst Felsbrocken es nicht mehr stoppen. Wegen dieser Veranlagung vergroesserte sich sein Lebensraum immer weiter.
it: Pokemon Punzoni
Quando inizia a correre non si ferma neanche se va a sbattere contro un macigno. Per questo il suo habitat ha continuato a ingrandirsi.
pt: Spikes Pokemon
Once it starts running, it won't stop-even if it crashes through boulders. This disposition is what's caused its habitat to expand.

es: Pokemon Taladro
Al evolucionar aprendio a andar sobre sus patas traseras, lo que le permitio expandir su habitat a montanas escarpadas.
en: Drill Pokemon
It evolved to walk using only its hind legs, which has allowed it to expand its habitat even onto steep mountains.
fr: Pokemon Perceur
Grace a son evolution, il peut se deplacer sur ses pattes arriere, ce qui lui a permis d'etendre son territoire aux montagnes escarpees.
de: Bohrer-Pokemon
Da es nach seiner Entwicklung aufrecht auf seinen Hinterbeinen gehen kann, erstreckt sich sein Lebensraum nun auch ueber raue Berge.
it: Pokemon Trapano
Grazie all'evoluzione puo camminare sulle sole zampe posteriori, per questo il suo habitat si e esteso fino a comprendere anche monti scoscesi.
pt: Drill Pokemon
It evolved to walk using only its hind legs, which has allowed it to expand its habitat even onto steep mountains.

es: Pokemon Huevo
Camina con cuidado para que no se rompa su huevo. Sin embargo, este Pokemon es extremadamente rapido escapando.
en: Egg Pokemon
It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
fr: Pokemon OEuf
Ce Pokemon marche lentement pour ne pas abimer son oeuf. Il est toutefois capable de s'enfuir tres vite.
de: Ei-Pokemon
Chaneira bewegt sich behutsam, damit sein Ei nicht zerbricht. Es kann jedoch sehr schnell davonlaufen.
it: Pokemon Uovo
Cammina con prudenza per non rompere il suo uovo. Tuttavia, puo fuggire con estrema rapidita.
pt: Egg Pokemon
It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

es: Pokemon Enredadera
Las lianas azules que lo recubren impiden ver su verdadero aspecto. Estas se usan como especia por la sensacion refrescante que producen al morderlas.
en: Vine Pokemon
It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed-they're useful as a spice.
fr: Pokemon Vigne
On ne peut distinguer son apparence, car son corps est cache sous ses lianes bleues. Celles-ci sont utilisees comme condiment, car elles offrent une sensation de fraicheur quand on les croque.
de: Ranken-Pokemon
Sein Koerper ist gaenzlich in blaue Ranken gehuellt, sodass seine wahre Gestalt ein Mysterium bleibt. Sie entfalten beim Kauen eine frische Note im Mund und eignen sich daher gut als Gewuerz.
it: Pokemon Liana
Cela le membra dietro una fitta trama di liane cerulee. Refrigeranti se masticate, queste liane vengono adoprate per insaporire pietanze.
pt: Vine Pokemon
It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed-they're useful as a spice.

es: Pokemon Maternal
Lleva a su cria en el marsupio. Solo deja que salga a jugar cuando no advierte peligro.
en: Parent Pokemon
It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.
fr: Pokemon Maternel
Ce Pokemon eleve son petit dans sa poche ventrale et il ne le laisse jouer dehors que lorsque l'environnement est suffisamment sur.
de: Muttertier-Pokemon
Es zieht seinen Nachwuchs in dem Beutel seines Bauches heran und laesst ihn nur hinaus zum Spielen, wenn es sich sicher fuehlt.
it: Pokemon Genitore
Alleva il suo piccolo nel marsupio sul ventre, lasciandolo uscire per giocare solo quando non ci sono pericoli.
pt: Parent Pokemon
It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

es: Pokemon Dragon
Se vale de su cola enroscada para mantener el equilibrio. En ocasiones, expulsa tinta por la boca.
en: Dragon Pokemon
It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.
fr: Pokemon Dragon
Ce Pokemon se maintient en equilibre grace a sa queue enroulee. Il peut cracher de l'encre.
de: Drachen-Pokemon
Es haelt mithilfe seines Schwanzes, der wie eine Spule aufgewickelt ist, das Gleichgewicht. Manchmal spuckt es Tinte aus seinem Mund.
it: Pokemon Drago
Si mantiene in equilibrio grazie alla coda avvolta a spirale. Puo sputare inchiostro dalla bocca.
pt: Dragon Pokemon
It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

es: Pokemon Dragon
Segrega veneno por la punta de las aletas. Estas y sus huesos son ingredientes muy valorados en la medicina tradicional.
en: Dragon Pokemon
Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.
fr: Pokemon Dragon
Les extremites de ses nageoires secretent du poison. Ces dernieres ainsi que ses os sont tres recherches en medecine naturelle.
de: Drachen-Pokemon
Aus seinen Flossenspitzen tritt Gift aus. Seine Flossen und Knochen stehen als Inhaltsstoffe fuer traditionelle Medizin hoch im Kurs.
it: Pokemon Drago
Secerne veleno dalla punta delle pinne. Le pinne e le ossa sono pregiati ingredienti nella preparazione di rimedi naturali.
pt: Dragon Pokemon
Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

es: Pokemon Pez Color
Nada a una velocidad de cinco nudos. Si se encuentra en peligro, usa su afilado cuerno para contraatacar.
en: Goldfish Pokemon
It swims at a steady five knots. If it senses danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.
fr: Pokemon Poisson
Il nage a une vitesse de cinq noeuds. Quand il se sent menace, il replique d'un coup de corne aiguisee.
de: Goldfisch-Pokemon
Dieses Pokemon, das mit einer Geschwindigkeit von bis zu fuenf Knoten schwimmt, wehrt sich bei Gefahr mit seinem spitzen Horn.
it: Pokemon Pescerosso
Nuota alla velocita di 5 nodi. Se avverte un pericolo, contrattacca con il suo corno aguzzo.
pt: Goldfish Pokemon
It swims at a steady five knots. If it senses danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.

es: Pokemon Pez Color
Lucha con su cuerno afilado como un taladro para proteger a su familia. Vive en agujeros horadados en las piedras del lecho del rio.
en: Goldfish Pokemon
To protect its family, it will fight with its drill-sharp horn. It lives in hollowed rocks in streams.
fr: Pokemon Poisson
Il protege sa famille a l'aide de sa corne pointue, qu'il utilise comme une perceuse. Il vit dans les trous des rochers au fond des rivieres.
de: Goldfisch-Pokemon
Dieses Pokemon lebt in ausgehoehlten Felsen im Flussbett und setzt sein spitzes Horn ein, um seine Familie zu beschuetzen.
it: Pokemon Pescerosso
Per proteggere la sua famiglia, attacca col corno appuntito come un trapano. Vive nelle cavita delle rocce sul letto dei fiumi.
pt: Goldfish Pokemon
To protect its family, it will fight with its drill-sharp horn. It lives in hollowed rocks in streams.

es: Pokemon Estrella
Puede regenerarse aunque le desgarren el cuerpo, siempre que su nucleo luminoso siga intacto.
en: Star Shape Pokemon
Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.
fr: Pokemon Etoile
Meme s'il est en lambeaux, il peut se regenerer tant que le noyau lumineux au centre de son corps est intact.
de: Sternform-Pokemon
Auch wenn sein Koerper auseinandergerissen wird, kann es sich regenerieren, solange sein leuchtender Kern intakt bleibt.
it: Pokemon Stella
A condizione che il nucleo luminoso centrale sia intatto, e in grado di rigenerarsi anche se il resto del corpo e ridotto a brandelli.
pt: Star Shape Pokemon
Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

es: Pokemon Misterioso
El nucleo rojo que tiene en el centro del cuerpo emite extranas senales de radio hacia el cielo nocturno.
en: Mysterious Pokemon
At the center of its body is a red core that sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
fr: Pokemon Mysterieux
La nuit, le noyau rouge au centre de son corps emet de mysterieuses ondes radio en direction du ciel.
de: Mysterioes-Pokemon
Der rote Kern in seiner Koerpermitte sendet mysterioese Radiowellen in den Nachthimmel.
it: Pokemon Misterioso
Al centro del corpo ha un nucleo rosso che diffonde misteriosi segnali radio nel cielo notturno.
pt: Mysterious Pokemon
At the center of its body is a red core that sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

es: Pokemon Barrera
Su aspecto recuerda al de un payaso, y su comportamiento al de un mimo. De la punta de sus dedos emana una energia con la que crea muros invisibles.
en: Barrier Pokemon
The behavior of this clown-like Pokemon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.
fr: Pokemon Bloqueur
Ce Pokemon, dont l'apparence evoque celle d'un saltimbanque, se meut tel un pantomime. Il peut creer des murs invisibles grace a l'energie emanant de l'extremite de ses doigts.
de: Sperren-Pokemon
Sein Aeusseres erinnert an einen Gaukler und sein Verhalten an einen Pantomimen. Mit der Kraft, die aus seinen Fingerspitzen stroemt, kann es unsichtbare Waende erzeugen.
it: Pokemon Barriera
Ha il sembiante di un pagliaccio e le movenze di un pantomimo. Materializza muri invisibili con l'uso di energia emessa dai polpastrelli.
pt: Barrier Pokemon
The behavior of this clown-like Pokemon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

es: Pokemon Mantis
Destroza a su presa con las guadanas que tiene. No es comun que use las alas para volar.
en: Mantis Pokemon
It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
fr: Pokemon Mante
Il dechiquette ses proies a l'aide de ses bras tranchants comme des faux. Il n'utilise que tres rarement ses ailes pour voler.
de: Mantis-Pokemon
Es erlegt seine Beute, indem es sie mit seinen scharfen Sicheln zerschlitzt. Seine Fluegel nutzt es nur aeusserst selten zum Fliegen.
it: Pokemon Mantide
Uccide le prede facendole a pezzi con le sue falci affilate. Solo raramente spiega le ali per spiccare il volo.
pt: Mantis Pokemon
It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

es: Pokemon Forma Humana
Sus gritos se parecen al lenguaje humano, pero es imposible entender lo que dice.
en: Human Shape Pokemon
Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
fr: Pokemon Humanoide
Son cri ressemble au langage humain, mais nul ne parvient a le comprendre.
de: Humanotyp-Pokemon
Sein Ruf klingt wie menschliche Sprache. Trotzdem ist nicht zu verstehen, was es sagt.
it: Pokemon Umanoide
I suoi versi ricordano il linguaggio umano, ma e impossibile capirne il significato.
pt: Human Shape Pokemon
Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

es: Pokemon Electrico
La comunidad cientifica estudia la posibilidad de almacenar en los Electabuzz la energia de los rayos para su posterior utilizacion.
en: Electric Pokemon
Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.
fr: Pokemon Electrique
Des scientifiques etudient la possibilite de stocker l'energie de la foudre dans des Elektek, pour qu'elle soit disponible a tout moment.
de: Elektro-Pokemon
Es wird danach geforscht, die Energie von Blitzen in Elektek zu speichern, um sie so jederzeit verfuegbar zu machen.
it: Pokemon Elettrico
Si sta attualmente studiando la possibilita di immagazzinare l'energia dei fulmini negli Electabuzz per poterla usare in seguito.
pt: Electric Pokemon
Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

es: Pokemon Escupefuego
La superficie de su cuerpo desprende unas ondeantes llamaradas que recuerdan a las fulguraciones solares.
en: Spitfire Pokemon
Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokemon's body.
fr: Pokemon Crache-Feu
Son corps emet des flammes ondoyantes comparables a celles du soleil.
de: Brenner-Pokemon
Auf der Oberflaeche seines Koerpers entstehen lodernde Flammen, die an die der Sonne erinnern.
it: Pokemon Sputafuoco
La superficie del suo corpo emana fiamme tremolanti simili a quelle del sole.
pt: Spitfire Pokemon
Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokemon's body.

es: Pokemon Escarabajo
Arremete violentamente con su cornamenta. Cuando llega el frio, se adentra en los bosques.
en: Stag Beetle Pokemon
It swings its long pincers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
fr: Pokemon Scarabee
Il attaque en agitant violemment ses longues cornes. En hiver, il se cache au plus profond des forets.
de: Kneifkaefer-Pokemon
Beim Angriff schwingt es seine langen Hoerner umher. In Kaelteperioden versteckt es sich tief im Wald.
it: Pokemon Cervolante
Quando attacca agita le lunghe corna. Nei periodi freddi resta nascosto nel profondo delle foreste.
pt: Stag Beetle Pokemon
It swings its long pincers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

es: Pokemon Toro Bravo
Luchan entre si con sus cuernos. Los miembros mas fuertes de la manada, a cargo de protegerla, alardean de las cicatrices de su cornamenta.
en: Wild Bull Pokemon

Bien qu'ils aient la meme capacite a cracher de l'eau, je n'ai realise que tardivement que ce Pokemon est l'evolution de Remoraid, tant ils sont dissemblables.
de: Hochdruck-Pokemon
Octillery schiesst zwar ebenso Wasser aus seinem Maul, doch da es so anders aussieht, glaubte man lange nicht, dass es sich bei ihm um die Entwicklung von Remoraid handelt.
it: Pokemon Jet
Puo eiettare acqua al pari di un Remoraid, ma a causa delle sembianze assai difformi si e per lungo tempo escluso che fosse il risultato della sua evoluzione.
pt: Jet Pokemon
While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

es: Pokemon Reparto
Transporta alimentos en la cola. Le gusta compartir su comida con los montanistas perdidos.
en: Delivery Pokemon
It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.
fr: Pokemon Livraison
Il enveloppe sa nourriture dans sa queue pour la transporter et partage volontiers ses victuailles avec les victimes d'accidents en montagne.
de: Lieferanten-Pokemon
Das Futter, das es in seinen Schweif eingewickelt bei sich traegt, teilt es mit Menschen, die sich in den Bergen verlaufen haben.
it: Pokemon Consegna
Trasporta il cibo avvolgendolo nella coda e ha l'abitudine di condividerlo con chi si perde fra le montagne.
pt: Delivery Pokemon
It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

es: Pokemon Milano
De personalidad docil, nada con elegancia por mar abierto. Puede saltar sobre la superficie del agua cuando va muy deprisa, por lo que suelen confundirlo con un Pokemon pajaro.
en: Kite Pokemon
This calm and gentle Pokemon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokemon due to this behavior.
fr: Pokemon Cervolant
Un Pokemon d'un naturel calme, qui nage avec joliesse. Lorsqu'il accelere, il lui arrive de bondir hors de l'eau, ce qui lui vaut d'etre souvent assimile a un Pokemon oiseau.
de: Flugrochen-Pokemon
Dieses friedliche Pokemon schwimmt anmutig durchs Meer. Wenn es beschleunigt, kann es auch kurz ueber den Wellen gleiten, wodurch es oft fuer ein Vogel-Pokemon gehalten wird.
it: Pokemon Aquilone
Di natura pacifica, nuota con grazia nell'oceano. Sott'acqua acquista velocita e, con un guizzo, si libra alto nell'aere tanto da venire spesso scambiato per un Pokemon alato.
pt: Kite Pokemon
This calm and gentle Pokemon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokemon due to this behavior.

es: Pokemon Coraza Ave
Como anida en zarzas, las plumas de sus polluelos crecen fortalecidas por los rasgunos.
en: Armor Bird Pokemon
Because it nests in bramble bushes, the feathers of its chicks grow hard from being scratched by thorns.
fr: Pokemon Armoiseau
Comme il fait son nid dans les ronces, les plumes de ses petits s'endurcissent a force d'etre sans cesse abimees.
de: Flugstahl-Pokemon
Da es in dornigem Gestruepp nistet, wachsen seine Jungen mit haeufigen Verletzungen durch Dornen auf, was ihre Federn abhaertet.

Fa il nido tra i rovi. Le ferite che i suoi piccoli riportano crescendo tra le spine ne induriscono le piume.
pt: Armor Bird Pokemon
Because it nests in bramble bushes, the feathers of its chicks grow hard from being scratched by thorns.

es: Pokemon Siniestro
Al amanecer, proclaman su territorio con un inquietante aullido que resuena en toda la zona.

Around dawn, their ominous howls echo through the area to announce their territory.
fr: Pokemon Sombre
A l'aube, ils poussent des hurlements sinistres qui resonnent aux alentours pour annoncer qu'ils controlent le territoire.
de: Hades
Mit dem ominoesen Heulen, das bei Morgengrauen ueber das Gebiet schallt, erheben diese Pokemon Anspruch auf ihr Territorium.
it: Pokemon Buio
All'alba, i suoi sinistri urli riecheggiano nell'aria. In questo modo marca il territorio.
pt: Dark Pokemon
Around dawn, their ominous howls echo through the area to announce their territory.

Su rasgo distintivo son los escalofriantes aullidos que profiere. Antiguamente, era temido y considerado un emisario del inframundo.
en: Dark Pokemon
Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.
fr: Pokemon Sombre
Ceux qui le craignaient jadis lui ont donne le surnom de messager de la Faucheuse a cause de son hurlement sinistre si particulier.
de: Hades
Sein unheimliches Heulen ist unverkennbar. Frueher wurde es von den Menschen als Bote des Todes gefuerchtet.
it: Pokemon Buio
Le sue urla sinistre sono inconfondibili. Un tempo era ritenuto un messaggero degli inferi e tutti lo temevano.
pt: Dark Pokemon
Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

es: Pokemon Dragon
Se dice que recarga energia durmiendo en los rincones mas profundos del oceano, alli donde ningun otro ser puede llegar.
en: Dragon Pokemon
This Pokemon is said to sleep at the bottom of the sea-deeper than any other life-form can descend-building its energy.
fr: Pokemon Dragon
On dit qu'il emmagasine de l'energie en dormant au plus profond des oceans, la ou nul autre etre vivant ne peut s'aventurer.
de: Drachen-Pokemon
Dieses Pokemon soll Kraft sammeln, indem es in Meerestiefen schlaeft, in die kein anderes Lebewesen vordringen kann.
it: Pokemon Drago
Si dice che accumuli energia dormendo sott'acqua, a profondita proibitive per ogni altra forma di vita.
pt: Dragon Pokemon
This Pokemon is said to sleep at the bottom of the sea-deeper than any other life-form can descend-building its energy.

es: Pokemon Narizotas
Es mucho mas fuerte de lo que aparenta. Un trompazo accidental podria fracturarle los huesos del brazo a una persona.
en: Long Nose Pokemon
It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter.
fr: Pokemon Long-Nez
Ce Pokemon est beaucoup plus fort qu'il n'y parait. Il peut casser le bras d'une personne d'un simple mouvement de trompe.
de: Langruessel
Es ist viel staerker, als es aussieht. Wenn es seinen Ruessel umherschwingt und einen dabei am Arm erwischt, ist dieser wahrscheinlich gebrochen.
it: Pokemon Nasone
E molto piu forte di quanto non sembri. Se si viene urtati dalla sua proboscide mentre la fa roteare, ci si puo rimettere il braccio.
pt: Long Nose Pokemon
It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter.

es: Pokemon Coraza
Por lo general se muestra tranquilo, pero, si lo enfadan, se enrolla hasta hacerse una bola y embiste rodando.
en: Armor Pokemon
Donphan is normally a calm Pokemon, but once it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and charge at you while rolling.
fr: Pokemon Armure
Ce Pokemon est d'un naturel calme. Cependant, lorsqu'on le provoque, il se met en boule et charge en roulant.
de: Panzer
Fuer gewoehnlich ist es von ruhigem Gemuet. Reizt man es jedoch, rollt es sich ein und donnert auf einen zu.
it: Pokemon Armatura
Di solito ha un'indole tranquilla, ma se qualcuno lo fa arrabbiare si appallottola e carica rotolando.
pt: Armor Pokemon

es: Pokemon Virtual
Esta version mejorada de Porygon se creo para posibilitar la exploracion de otros planetas, pero ni siquiera es capaz de volar aun.

Porygon was upgraded to become capable of planetary development. However, this upgraded version cannot even fly yet.
fr: Pokemon Virtuel
Cette version amelioree de Porygon a ete creee pour le developpement planetaire, mais elle ne peut toujours pas voler.

Diese verbesserte Version von Porygon wurde fuer die Erschliessung anderer Planeten gebaut, jedoch kann sie noch nicht einmal fliegen.

Questa versione aggiornata di Porygon e adatta allo sviluppo planetario, anche se non e ancora in grado di volare.
pt: Virtual Pokemon
Porygon was upgraded to become capable of planetary development. However, this upgraded version cannot even fly yet.

es: Pokemon Gran Cuerno
Se dice que antano habia alcanzado un estadio evolutivo superior como respuesta a la profusion de enemigos.

It's said that this Pokemon used to be stronger long ago when it had many enemies, and that it was even able to evolve under its own power.
fr: Pokemon Maxi Corne
On dit qu'il etait autrefois plus puissant et meme capable d'evoluer, car il avait davantage de rivaux.

Vor langer Zeit, als es zahlreiche natuerliche Feinde hatte, soll es staerker gewesen sein und sich aus eigener Kraft entwickelt haben.

In passato aveva molti nemici. Si dice che per questo fosse piu forte e addirittura capace di evolversi con le proprie forze.

es: Pokemon Pintor
El color del misterioso fluido que segrega por la punta de la cola varia en funcion de cada individuo.

The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from the tip of the tail is predetermined for each Smeargle.
fr: Pokemon Peintre
La couleur du mysterieux fluide secrete par le bout de sa queue varie selon chaque individu.
de: Maler
Die Farbe des mysterioesen Sekrets, das aus ihrer Schweifspitze austritt, variiert je nach Farbeagle.
it: Pokemon Pittore
Il colore del fluido misterioso che secerne dalla coda cambia da esemplare a esemplare.
pt: Painter Pokemon
The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from the tip of the tail is predetermined for each Smeargle.

es: Pokemon Peleon
Con el fin de volverse cada vez mas fuerte, combate contra todo el que se le ponga por delante para entrenar su cuerpo sin mesura.
en: Scuffle Pokemon
Its intense desire to become stronger and stronger drives it to recklessly train its body and challenge any opponent it can find to battle.
fr: Pokemon Bagarreur
Son desir de devenir toujours plus fort le pousse a entrainer son corps sans relache et a defier tout ce qui bouge.
de: Racker-Pokemon
Um immer staerker zu werden, staehlt es seinen Koerper wie besessen und fordert absolut jeden zum Kampf heraus, der ihm ueber den Weg laeuft.
it: Pokemon Baruffa
Punta a diventare sempre piu forte, percio si allena ossessivamente sfidando chiunque si ritrovi di fronte.
pt: Scuffle Pokemon

es: Pokemon Boca Abajo
Su cuerno, que no deja de crecerle durante toda la vida, le sirve como eje para girar mientras propina sus elegantes patadas.

It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.
fr: Pokemon Poirier
Il assene de gracieux coups de pied tout en tournoyant sur sa corne. Cette derniere continue de pousser tout au long de sa vie.

Es dreht sich auf seinem Horn um die eigene Achse und teilt dabei elegante Tritte aus. Das Horn waechst sein ganzes Leben lang weiter.

Sferra eleganti calci ruotando su se stesso. Usa come perno il corno, che continua a crescere per tutta la sua vita.

It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

Analiza todo tocandolo con los labios, los cuales son capaces de recordar las cosas que le gustan y disgustan.

It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
fr: Pokemon Bisou
Ce Pokemon touche a tout du bout de ses levres. Celles-ci gardent en memoire ce qui lui a plu et ce qui lui a deplu.
de: Kuss-Pokemon
Dieses Pokemon beruehrt alles Moegliche pruefend mit seinen Lippen, die sich dann merken, was es mag und was nicht.

Analizza tutto con le labbra e con esse riesce a memorizzare cio che gli piace e cio che non gli piace.
pt: Kiss Pokemon
It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

es: Pokemon Electrico
Gira los brazos para generar electricidad, pero se cansa enseguida, asi que almacena muy poca.

It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.
fr: Pokemon Electrique
Il fait pivoter ses bras pour generer de l'electricite, mais comme il se fatigue vite, il ne peut en stocker qu'une petite quantite.

Es laesst seine Arme kreisen, um Elektrizitaet zu generieren, doch da es schnell muede wird, erzeugt es nur eine kleine Menge.

Genera elettricita ruotando le braccia, ma dato che si stanca subito non riesce ad accumularne molta.

es: Pokemon Ascuas
La sangre que corre por sus venas es como el magma, lo que eleva su temperatura corporal hasta los 600 oC.

Magma-like blood circulates throughout this Pokemon's body, raising its body temperature as high as 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

Du sang comparable a du magma coule dans ses veines. La temperature de son corps peut ainsi atteindre les 600 C.

Durch seinen Koerper fliesst magmaartiges Blut, welches seine Koerpertemperatur auf ganze 600 C steigen lassen kann.

Il liquido che gli scorre nelle vene e simile al magma. Per questo, la sua temperatura corporea puo raggiungere anche i 600 oC.
pt: Live Coal Pokemon
Magma-like blood circulates throughout this Pokemon's body, raising its body temperature as high as 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

es: Pokemon Lechera
Dicen que, si un nino bebe leche de Miltank, se convertira en un adulto sano y campechano.

It is said that kids who drink Miltank's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

On dit que les enfants eleves au lait d'Ecremeuh deviennent des adultes en bonne sante et robustes.

Es heisst, dass Kinder, die Miltanks Milch trinken, zu gesunden, starken Erwachsenen heranwachsen.
it: Pokemon Bovino
Si dice che i bambini cresciuti bevendo il latte di Miltank diventino adulti sani e forti.
pt: Milk Cow Pokemon
It is said that kids who drink Miltank's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

es: Pokemon Felicidad
Los huevos que pone estan llenos de felicidad. Solo con probar un poquito de uno, cualquiera sonrie.

The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
fr: Pokemon Bonheur
Les oeufs que pond Leuphorie sont un concentre de bonheur. Une bouchee de ces oeufs suffit a faire sourire n'importe qui.

Eier, die es legt, stecken voller Froehlichkeit. Schon ein Bissen erzeugt ein breites Laecheln.
it: Pokemon Felicita
Le uova che depone sono un concentrato di felicita: basta un assaggio per recuperare subito il sorriso.
pt: Happiness Pokemon
The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

es: Pokemon Trueno
Dicen que cayo del cielo con un relampago. Puede lanzar rayos desde las nubes de su lomo.
en: Thunder Pokemon
It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
fr: Pokemon Foudre
On dit qu'il est tombe avec la foudre. Les nuages sur son dos sont capables de lancer des eclairs.
de: Donner-Pokemon
Es wird erzaehlt, dass es mit Blitz und Donner vom Himmel kam. Aus der Regenwolke auf seinem Ruecken kann es Blitze schleudern.
it: Pokemon Tuono
Si dice che sia venuto giu assieme a un fulmine. Puo scagliare saette dalle nuvole di pioggia che ha sul dorso.
pt: Thunder Pokemon
It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

es: Pokemon Volcan
Se dice que, cuando ruge, un volcan entra en erupcion en algun punto del globo.

It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
fr: Pokemon Volcan
On raconte qu'a chaque fois qu'il rugit, un volcan entre en eruption quelque part.
de: Vulkan-Pokemon
Es heisst, wenn Entei bruellt, breche irgendwo auf der Welt ein Vulkan aus.
it: Pokemon Vulcano
Si dice che, quando emette il suo verso, da qualche parte nel mondo un vulcano erutti.

It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

es: Pokemon Aurora
Recorre el mundo purificando agua contaminada. Corre veloz con el viento del norte.

It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
fr: Pokemon Aurore
Ce Pokemon parcourt le vaste monde pour purifier les eaux polluees. Il accompagne le vent du nord.
de: Polarlicht-Pokemon
Es durchstreift die Welt, um verschmutztes Wasser zu reinigen, und zieht mit dem Nordwind wieder davon.
it: Pokemon Aurora
Corre per tutto il mondo per purificare l'acqua contaminata. Si allontana con i venti del nord.
pt: Aurora Pokemon
It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

es: Pokemon Piel Roca
Se alimenta de tierra. Despues de devorar el equivalente a una montana, se duerme y empieza a crecer.

It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
fr: Pokemon Peaupierre
Il vit en se nourrissant de terre. Apres avoir devore une montagne, il s'endort et entame sa croissance.
de: Felshaut-Pokemon
Es ernaehrt sich von Erde. Nachdem es einen Berg verspeist hat, schlaeft es ein, um zu wachsen.

Si nutre di terra. Dopo aver divorato una montagna intera, si addormenta per poter crescere.

It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

es: Pokemon Caparazon
Su cuerpo es duro como la roca. Se propulsa como un cohete expulsando los gases comprimidos de su interior.

Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
fr: Pokemon Carapadure
Son corps est dur comme la roche souterraine. Il file comme une fusee en expulsant des gaz comprimes.

Sein Koerper ist hart wie Fels. Indem es komprimiertes Gas ausstoesst, kann es wie eine Rakete in die Luefte schiessen.
it: Pokemon Guscioduro
Il suo corpo e duro come la roccia. Emette getti di gas pressurizzato per decollare come un razzo.

Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

es: Pokemon Coraza
Cuando se enfada, altera el paisaje derribando montanas y enterrando rios. Da mucho trabajo a los cartografos.
en: Armor Pokemon
If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
fr: Pokemon Armure
Lorsqu'il est dechaine, les montagnes s'effondrent et les fleuves sont ensevelis. On doit alors redessiner les cartes.
de: Panzer-Pokemon
Wenn Despotar tobt, zerstoert es Berge und verschuettet Fluesse, sodass Landkarten neu gezeichnet werden muessen.
it: Pokemon Armatura
Quando s'infuria disintegra montagne e ricopre di terra fiumi interi, per cui le mappe devono essere ridisegnate.
pt: Armor Pokemon
If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

es: Pokemon Buceo
Duerme en lo mas profundo de una fosa marina. Se dice que causa tormentas de 40 dias cuando bate las alas.
en: Diving Pokemon
It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
fr: Pokemon Plongeon
Il dort au fond d'une fosse sous-marine. On dit qu'il peut provoquer une tempete de quarante jours d'un battement d'ailes.
de: Taucher-Pokemon
Lugia schlaeft am Grund eines Tiefseegrabens. Es heisst, mit seinem Fluegelschlag koenne es einen Sturm ausloesen, der 40 Tage andauert.
it: Pokemon Immersione
Dorme in una fossa negli abissi marini. Si dice che con un battito d'ali possa provocare una tempesta di 40 giorni.
pt: Diving Pokemon
It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

es: Pokemon Arcoiris
Su plumaje tiene siete colores. Se dice que verlo proporciona felicidad eterna.
en: Rainbow Pokemon
Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
fr: Pokemon Arcenciel
Ses ailes arborent sept couleurs differentes. On dit que le voir est promesse de bonheur eternel.
de: Regenbogen-Pokemon
Es heisst, dass demjenigen, der dieses Pokemon mit seinen siebenfarbigen Schwingen erblickt, ewiges Glueck beschieden sei.
it: Pokemon Arcobaleno
Le sue piume sono di sette colori. Si dice che chiunque lo veda sara felice per sempre.
pt: Rainbow Pokemon
Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

es: Pokemon Viajetiempo
Puede viajar en el tiempo, pero se dice que solo aparece en tiempos de paz.
en: Time Travel Pokemon
It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
fr: Pokemon Temporel
Il a le pouvoir de voyager dans le temps. On dit qu'il n'apparait qu'en temps de paix.
de: Zeitreise-Pokemon
Es ist in der Lage, durch die Zeit zu reisen, zeigt sich jedoch nur in Friedenszeiten.
it: Pokemon Tempovia
Ha il potere di viaggiare attraverso il tempo, ma si dice che appaia solo in periodi di pace.
pt: Time Travel Pokemon
It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

es: Pokemon Geco Bosque
Escala con rapidez incluso superficies verticales. Percibe la humedad ambiental con la cola y asi preve el tiempo que hara al dia siguiente.
en: Wood Gecko Pokemon
Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.
fr: Pokemon Bois Gecko
Il grimpe sur les murs avec une grande agilite. Sa queue lui permet de mesurer l'humidite et de predire ainsi le temps qu'il fera le lendemain.
de: Waldgecko-Pokemon
Es kann selbst Waende blitzschnell emporklettern. Mit seinem Schwanz misst es die Luftfeuchtigkeit, um das Wetter des naechsten Tages vorherzusagen.

Riesce a scalare rapidamente anche pareti verticali. Rileva l'umidita attraverso la coda per prevedere il tempo dell'indomani.
pt: Wood Gecko Pokemon
Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.

es: Pokemon Geco Bosque
Se desplaza saltando gracilmente de rama en rama por los arboles mas altos, haciendo gala de su tremenda agilidad.
en: Wood Gecko Pokemon
Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with astounding speed and force.

Il se deplace dans les grands arbres en sautant avec agilite de branche en branche. Sa vivacite est extraordinaire.
de: Waldgecko-Pokemon
Es verfuegt ueber eine erstaunliche Sprungkraft und bewegt sich auf hohen Baeumen mit Leichtigkeit von Ast zu Ast fort.
it: Pokemon Legnogeco
Si sposta saltando agilmente tra i rami di grandi alberi. E capace di scatti impressionanti.
pt: Wood Gecko Pokemon
Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with astounding speed and force.

es: Pokemon Monte
Las hojas que le crecen en los brazos estan afiladas como cuchillas. Ataca a sus enemigos saltando gracilmente de rama en rama.
en: Forest Pokemon
The leaves on its arms are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike its enemies.
fr: Pokemon Foret
Les feuilles sur ses bras sont aussi tranchantes que des epees. Il saute habilement de branche en branche avant de fondre sur sa cible.
de: Dschungel-Pokemon
Die Blaetter an seinen Armen sind so scharf wie Schwerter. Es huepft muehelos von Ast zu Ast und stuerzt sich dann auf seine Feinde.
it: Pokemon Foresta
Le foglie sugli arti anteriori sono affilate come lame. Assale i nemici saltando agilmente di ramo in ramo.
pt: Forest Pokemon
The leaves on its arms are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike its enemies.

es: Pokemon Polluelo
La saca de fuego que arde en el interior de su abdomen hace que al abrazarlo este tan caliente como un calientapies.
en: Chick Pokemon
In its belly, it has a sac filled with burning fire, meaning that Torchic feels as warm as a hot-water bottle if you hug it.
fr: Pokemon Poussin
Une poche a flammes brule dans son ventre. Quand on le caline, on a donc l'impression d'avoir une bouillotte dans les bras.
de: Kueken-Pokemon
Flemmli traegt einen Flammensack in seinem Bauch. Daher fuehlt es sich so warm wie eine Waermflasche an, wenn man es im Arm haelt.
it: Pokemon Pulcino
Nel ventre ha una sacca di fuoco. Per questo, abbracciarlo da la stessa sensazione di stringere una borsa d'acqua calda.
pt: Chick Pokemon
In its belly, it has a sac filled with burning fire, meaning that Torchic feels as warm as a hot-water bottle if you hug it.

es: Pokemon Ave Corral
Al combatir, el fuego de su interior se intensifica. Es capaz de propinar unas patadas demoledoras.
en: Young Fowl Pokemon
When it enters battle, the flame inside its body burns stronger. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

Quand il se bat, les flammes dans son corps se mettent a bruler ardemment. Ses coups de pied sont devastateurs.

Im Kampf lodert das Feuer in seinem Koerper auf. Seine Tritte besitzen eine aussergewoehnliche Zerstoerungskraft.

Quando deve lottare, il suo fuoco interiore brucia intensamente. Sferra calci dalla notevole potenza distruttiva.

Puede saltar edificios de 30 plantas. Reduce a cenizas a sus rivales con sus punetazos de fuego.

It can jump powerfully, clearing a 30-story building in a single leap. Its flaming punches scorch its opponents.

Sa detente lui permet de bondir par-dessus un batiment de trente etages. Il carbonise ses adversaires avec ses poings enflammes.

Es kann ueber 30-stoeckige Haeuser springen. Seine feurigen Schlaege lassen seine Gegner in Flammen aufgehen.

Riesce a superare un edificio di 30 piani con un salto. I suoi pugni di fuoco inceneriscono il nemico.

Batir su gran aleta caudal en el agua le permite nadar muy rapido. A pesar de su reducido tamano, tiene mucha fuerza.

When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.

Dans l'eau, les battements de sa grande nageoire caudale le font accelerer de maniere fulgurante. Malgre sa petite taille, il est tres costaud.

Wenn es seine grosse Schwanzflosse einsetzt, kann es im Wasser schnell beschleunigen. Es ist ueberraschend stark fuer seine geringe Groesse.

Puo acquisire una straordinaria velocita agitando la grande pinna caudale nell'acqua. E minuto, ma forte.

es: Pokemon Pez Lodo
Esta en su salsa en terrenos lodosos, donde aprovecha la reducida movilidad de sus rivales para someterlos en un abrir y cerrar de ojos.

It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.

En terrain boueux, il peut exprimer son plein potentiel et dominer rapidement les adversaires embourbes qui peinent a se mouvoir.

Auf instabilem, schlammigem Untergrund kann es sein wahres Potenzial entfalten. Feststeckende Gegner ueberwaeltigt es im Handumdrehen.

Da il meglio di se nei terreni fangosi, dove approfitta della mobilita ridotta degli avversari per sopraffarli in un attimo.

es: Pokemon Pez Lodo
Tiene unos brazos duros como la roca, con los que puede dejar molido al enemigo de un solo golpe. Construye su nido en playas bonitas.

Swampert's arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down Swampert's foes. This Pokemon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

Ses bras sont aussi durs que la roche. Il peut terrasser ses adversaires d'un simple coup. Il aime faire son nid sur les jolies plages.
de: Lehmhuepfer-Pokemon
Seine Arme sind steinhart. Mit nur einem Schlag kann es Gegner zu Boden strecken. Es baut sein Nest an pittoresken Straenden.
it: Pokemon Fango Pesce
Ha braccia dure come roccia, capaci di abbattere l'avversario in un colpo. Nidifica su splendide spiagge.
pt: Mud Fish Pokemon
Swampert's arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down Swampert's foes. This Pokemon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

es: Pokemon Mordisco
Persiguen a su presa en jaurias. Esperan a que se agote para darle el golpe de gracia, pero, si esta contraataca, salen corriendo.
en: Bite Pokemon
Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

Ils chassent leurs proies en meute et les achevent quand elles sont a bout de force. Dans les rares cas ou elles ripostent, ils preferent fuir.

Es jagt Beute im Rudel nach. Ist diese erschoepft, bringt es sie zur Strecke. Stoesst Fiffyen jedoch auf Widerstand, ergreift es auch mal die Flucht.
it: Pokemon Morso
Inseguono la preda in branco e la finiscono quando e esausta, ma se capita che questa contrattacchi scappano.

Cuando detectan el olor de una presa lejana, toda la jauria se pone en movimiento a las ordenes del lider.
en: Bite Pokemon
Once it's caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack moves out.
fr: Pokemon Morsure
Quand des Grahyena flairent l'odeur d'une proie lointaine, toute leur meute se met en mouvement sous les ordres du chef.

Sobald es Beute in grosser Entfernung wittert, setzt sich das gesamte Rudel auf Befehl des Anfuehrers hin sofort in Bewegung.
it: Pokemon Morso
Quando fiuta l'odore di una preda in lontananza, il branco si muove unito seguendo gli ordini del capobranco.

Once it's caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack moves out.

es: Pokemon Mapachito
Se mueve en zigzag. Se le da bien encontrar objetos ocultos en la hierba e incluso enterrados.
en: Tiny Raccoon Pokemon
It walks in zigzag fashion. It's good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
fr: Pokemon Petit Raton
Il marche en zigzaguant et n'a pas son pareil pour denicher des tresors dans l'herbe ou sous terre.
de: Kleindachs-Pokemon
Es laeuft im Zickzack und ist gut darin, im Gras oder unter der Erde verborgene Schaetze zu finden.
it: Pokemon Procione
Avanza a zigzag. E bravo a trovare strumenti nell'erba e sul terreno.
pt: Tiny Raccoon Pokemon
It walks in zigzag fashion. It's good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

es: Pokemon Lanzado
Carga contra sus presas a mas de 100 km/h, pero, como solo puede correr en linea recta, falla a menudo.

It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
fr: Pokemon Fonceur
Il fonce sur sa proie a une vitesse de 100 km/h mais il rate souvent sa cible, car il ne peut courir qu'en ligne droite.
de: Sprinter-Pokemon
Es stuerzt sich mit 100 km/h auf seine Beute. Da es nur geradeaus laufen kann, scheitern seine Jagdversuche dennoch haeufig.
it: Pokemon Sfrecciante
Carica la preda a una velocita di 100 km/h. Ma dal momento che va solo dritto, spesso la manca.
pt: Rushing Pokemon

es: Pokemon Gusano
Adoran la savia y es comun encontrarlos por el campo. Se desconoce por que adoptan formas diferentes al evolucionar, y su aspecto no sirve para determinar cual de ellas adoptaran.
en: Worm Pokemon
Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.
fr: Pokemon Ver
Ce Pokemon friand de seve gite dans les plaines et montagnes. On ignore pourquoi il a deux evolutions possibles, et son aspect ne permet guere d'entrevoir quelle forme il revetira.
de: Wurm
Waumpel mag Baumsaft und ist oft in den Ebenen und Bergen zu finden. Es ist unklar, warum es zwei Entwicklungsformen hat, und man kann ihm nicht ansehen, welche es annehmen wird.
it: Pokemon Baco
Ama la linfa e si trova facilmente in piane e monti. La sua evoluzione e, per qualche oscura ragione, biforme e non e prevedibile dal suo aspetto.
pt: Worm Pokemon

Envuelto en una seda muy fina, acumula energia para evolucionar. Se mueve con dificultad al tener las extremidades inmovilizadas, pero lo observa todo y no pierde detalle.
en: Cocoon Pokemon
Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout-Silcoon is always on guard.
fr: Pokemon Cocon
Il s'enveloppe dans des fils de soie en attendant d'accumuler l'energie necessaire a son evolution. Ses membres entraves le ralentissent, mais il a l'oeil vif et reste toujours aux aguets.
de: Kokon
Es wickelt sich in feine Faeden und sammelt Energie fuer seine Entwicklung. Da es seine Gliedmassen nicht einsetzen kann, ist es recht schwerfaellig, doch seinem scharfen Blick entgeht nichts.
it: Pokemon Bozzolo
Avvolge le membra in fili sottili per accumulare energia per l'evoluzione. Lento nel muoversi, ha gli arti bloccati, ma i suoi occhi sono attenti e vigili.
pt: Cocoon Pokemon
Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout-Silcoon is always on guard.

es: Pokemon Mariposa
De colores vivos y gran belleza, este Pokemon es muy avaricioso y ahuyenta a los Combee para hacerse con el nectar que recolectan, pues no le gusta compartir su comida favorita.
en: Butterfly Pokemon
A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokemon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.
fr: Pokemon Papillon
Ce Pokemon majestueux aux ailes eclatantes est vorace : il chasse les Apitrini qui recoltent du miel afin de ne pas avoir a partager son mets favori.
de: Falter
Aufgrund seiner Farbenpracht mag es schoen anzusehen sein, doch es hat ein gieriges Wesen. Es vertreibt Wadribie, die auf Nektarsuche sind, um sein Leibgericht ganz fuer sich zu haben.
it: Pokemon Farfalla
Multicolore e bello alla vista, e di natura avida. Scaccia i Combee che raccolgono nettare per tenere per se il suo nutrimento favorito.
pt: Butterfly Pokemon

La seda que lo envuelve es fina pero resistente, y de un color y un lustre superiores a la de Silcoon. Las prendas hechas con ella son muy apreciadas.
en: Cocoon Pokemon
The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.
fr: Pokemon Cocon
Les fils de soie dans lesquels il s'enveloppe sont fins, mais resistants. D'une qualite superieure a ceux d'Armulys, ils servent a confectionner des vetements reputes pour leur raffinement.
de: Kokon
Es wickelt sich in feine, aber robuste Faeden, deren Glanz und Farbe denen von Schaloko ueberlegen sind. Daraus gefertigte Kleidung gilt als besonders hochwertig.

Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.
fr: Pokemon Papipoison
Les Papinox ont coutume de se reunir nuitamment autour des feux. Il est fort delicat de les chasser du village, car ils projettent des ecailles empoisonnees.

Dieses Pokemon wird des Nachts von Lagerfeuern angezogen. Da es giftigen Puder verstreut, ist es nur schwer aus Siedlungen zu verscheuchen.

Lotad will gather in lakes that have good water quality. The surfaces of these lakes sometimes become covered in Lotad leaves.

Les Nenupiot se rassemblent dans les etangs a l'eau pure. Ils sont parfois si nombreux que leurs feuilles en recouvrent totalement la surface.

Loturzel versammeln sich in Scharen auf Teichen mit guter Wasserqualitaet. Dabei kommt es vor, dass ihre Blaetter die ganze Oberflaeche bedecken.

Si concentrano nei laghi dall'acqua pulita, arrivando a volte a ricoprirne l'intera superficie con le loro foglie.

Il aime les berges abondantes en nourriture et il est devenu nocturne pour ne pas avoir a disputer ses repas aux Pokemon oiseaux.

Es bevorzugt Ufer, an denen es viel Futter findet. Um sich nicht mit Vogel-Pokemon darum streiten zu muessen, wurde es nachtaktiv.

Ama gli specchi d'acqua ricchi di cibo. E diventato notturno per non doverselo contendere con i Pokemon alati.

Dancing with an upbeat rhythm energizes and emboldens it, letting it face any foe without fear.

Danser sur un rythme endiable lui insuffle un tel dynamisme qu'il finit par ne plus craindre aucun ennemi.

Tanzt es zu froehlichen Rhythmen, steigt seine Stimmung und jegliche Angst vor seinen Feinden verfliegt.

Quando danza al ritmo di una musica festosa, si esalta al punto da perdere ogni paura del nemico.

es: Pokemon Bellota
Viven colgados de las ramas de los arboles y absorben su humedad. Los arboles mas grandes y jovenes atraen mayor cantidad de Seedot.

Seedot live in trees, hanging from the branches and leeching moisture. Rows of them can be found dangling from large, young trees.

Il se suspend aux branches des arbres et en absorbe l'eau. On trouve parfois plusieurs Grainipiot alignes sur les jeunes arbres imposants.

Es haengt von Aesten herab und lebt dort, indem es ihnen Feuchtigkeit entzieht. An grossen, jungen Baeumen finden sich reihenweise Samurzel.

Vive appeso ai rami degli alberi, assorbendone l'umidita. Gli alberi giovani e grandi attraggono un maggior numero di Seedot.

En su puntiaguda nariz se concentran varios receptores que le permiten percibir su entorno, pero tambien es su punto debil.

Its sensory functions are concentrated in its pointed nose, which it uses to sense its surroundings. The nose is also its weak point.
fr: Pokemon Malin
Son nez pointu regroupe plusieurs fonctions sensorielles qui lui permettent d'analyser son environnement. C'est egalement son point faible.

In seiner spitzen Nase konzentrieren sich viele Sinnesrezeptoren, mit denen es seine Umgebung wahrnimmt, doch sie ist auch sein Schwachpunkt.

Il suo naso appuntito concentra in se le funzioni sensoriali e gli permette di percepire cio che lo circonda. Tuttavia, e anche il suo punto debole.

Cuenta la leyenda que se trata de un Pokemon pajaro cuyo pico y alas fueron transformados como castigo divino por cometer maldades.

Legends tell of a bird Pokemon that received divine punishment for its evil deeds and had its beak and wings replaced.
fr: Pokemon Malveillant
Selon la legende, il etait autrefois un Pokemon oiseau malfaisant qui perdit son bec et ses ailes apres avoir subi un chatiment divin.

Laut einer Legende war es ein Vogel-Pokemon, das als goettliche Strafe fuer seine Missetaten seine Fluegel und seinen Schnabel einbuessen musste.

Secondo le leggende, un tempo era un Pokemon alato a cui vennero mutati becco e ali come punizione divina per le proprie cattive azioni.

es: Pokemon Pequebuche
Un Pokemon valiente que no teme a los rivales fuertes. Vuela en busca de climas templados.

It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
fr: Pokemon Minirondel
Ce Pokemon temeraire n'a pas peur d'affronter des ennemis puissants. Il vole en quete de climats chauds.

Dieses mutige Pokemon schreckt auch vor starken Gegnern nicht zurueck. Auf der Suche nach warmem Klima fliegt es stets an neue Orte.
it: Pokemon Rondinella
E molto coraggioso e affronta spavaldo anche i nemici piu forti. Migra verso i paesi caldi.

It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

es: Pokemon Buche
Vuela en circulos a gran altura en busca de presas. Cuando ve una, se lanza en picado para atraparla.
en: Swallow Pokemon
It circles the sky in search of prey and dives sharply to catch its target.
fr: Pokemon Hirondelle
Ce Pokemon decrit des cercles dans le ciel en quete d'une proie. Des qu'il en a repere une, il fond sur elle en pique pour la capturer.
de: Schwalbe
Auf der Suche nach Beute kreist dieses Pokemon am Himmel. Wird es fuendig, setzt es zum Sturzflug an und schnappt sie sich.
it: Pokemon Rondine
Vola in tondo alla ricerca di prede. Quando ne avvista una, si lancia in picchiata per catturarla.

es: Pokemon Gaviota
Vuela y planea siguiendo la brisa marina. En invierno esconde comida cerca de su nido.
en: Seagull Pokemon
It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.
fr: Pokemon Mouette
Il utilise les vents marins comme un planeur. En hiver, il cache de la nourriture autour de son nid.
de: Seemoewen-Pokemon
Es nutzt den Seewind, um wie ein Segelflugzeug durch die Luefte zu gleiten. Im Winter versteckt es Nahrung bei seinem Nest.
it: Pokemon Gabbiano
Vola scivolando sulla brezza marina come un aliante. D'inverno, nasconde il cibo attorno al nido.
pt: Seagull Pokemon
It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

es: Pokemon Ave Agua
Protege a sus crias de los enemigos metiendolas en su pico. En dias de poco oleaje, reposa sobre el agua.
en: Water Bird Pokemon
It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.
fr: Pokemon Oiseaudo
Il protege ses petits en les abritant dans son bec. Quand la mer est calme, il se repose sur l'eau.
de: Wasservogel-Pokemon
Es traegt seine Jungen zum Schutz vor Feinden im Schnabel. Bei Windstille treibt es auf den Wellen, um sich auszuruhen.
it: Pokemon Alacquatico
Protegge i piccoli nascondendoli nel becco. Nei giorni di mare calmo, si riposa galleggiando sulle onde.
pt: Water Bird Pokemon
It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

es: Pokemon Sensible
Si sus cuernos rojizos perciben emociones positivas de personas o Pokemon, su cuerpo se calienta un poco.
en: Feeling Pokemon
If its red horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokemon, its body warms up slightly.
fr: Pokemon Sentiment
Quand ses cornes rouges captent les ondes positives d'un Pokemon ou d'un humain, tout son corps se rechauffe.
de: Gefuehls-Pokemon
Wenn es mit seinen roten Hoernern freundliche Gefuehle von Menschen oder Pokemon erfasst, erwaermt sich sein ganzer Koerper ein bisschen.
it: Pokemon Sensazione
Se con le sue corna rosse avverte emozioni positive di persone o Pokemon, il suo corpo si scalda leggermente.
pt: Feeling Pokemon
If its red horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokemon, its body warms up slightly.

es: Pokemon Sensorio
La alegria de su Entrenador alimenta sus poderes psiquicos. Cuando esta contento, baila girando sobre si mismo.
en: Emotion Pokemon
The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
fr: Pokemon Emotion
Ils tirent leurs pouvoirs psychiques de la bonne humeur de leurs Dresseurs. Ils dansent en tournant sur eux-memes quand ils sont heureux.
de: Emotions-Pokemon
Die froehliche Stimmung seines Trainers ist die Quelle seiner Psycho-Kraefte. Wenn es gluecklich ist, dreht es sich und tanzt.
it: Pokemon Emozione
Piu il suo Allenatore e felice, piu i suoi poteri psichici sono potenti. Quando e di buonumore, si lancia in danze e piroette.
pt: Emotion Pokemon

es: Pokemon Envolvente
Tiene la capacidad de predecir el futuro. Exhibe su maximo potencial cuando tiene que proteger a su Entrenador.
en: Embrace Pokemon
It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
fr: Pokemon Etreinte
Ce Pokemon est capable de predire l'avenir. Il deploie toute sa puissance quand il doit proteger son Dresseur ou sa Dresseuse.
de: Umarmungs-Pokemon
Es kann die Zukunft vorhersagen. Beschuetzt es seinen Trainer, erreicht seine Kraft ihren Hoehepunkt.
it: Pokemon Abbraccio
Ha la capacita di prevedere il futuro. Quando deve proteggere il suo Allenatore, mette in mostra tutta la sua potenza.
pt: Embrace Pokemon
It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

es: Pokemon Zapatero
Del extremo de su cabeza mana un liquido de aroma almibarado. Vive en estanques repletos de plantas.
en: Pond Skater Pokemon
It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.
fr: Pokemon Maresurfeur
Ce Pokemon vit dans les etangs ou prosperent les plantes hydrophiles. Le sommet de sa tete secrete un liquide au parfum sucre.

Aus dem Fortsatz an seinem Kopf sondert es eine suess duftende, sirupartige Fluessigkeit ab. Es lebt in Tuempeln, die reich an Wasserpflanzen sind.
it: Pokemon Sfiorapozze
Il suo capo secerne un liquido dal dolce profumo simile a sciroppo. Vive negli stagni ricchi di piante acquatiche.
pt: Pond Skater Pokemon

es: Pokemon Globocular
En las antenas tiene un par de ojos dibujados. Cuando llueve, se le vuelven muy pesadas y le impiden volar.
