Hay que ir con cuidado al adentrarse en un bosque en el que no haya indicio de seres vivos, pues puede tratarse del territorio de Hatterene.
en: Silent Pokemon
Beware of forests that show no signs of living creatures within. You may have wandered into Hatterene's territory.
fr: Pokemon Silencieux
Il faut se mefier des forets depourvues de tout signe de vie : il s'agit peut-etre des territoires de Sorcilence.
de: Stille-Pokemon
Bei Waeldern ohne Anzeichen von Leben sollte man Vorsicht walten lassen. Es ist gut moeglich, dass man sich im Revier eines Silembrim befindet.
it: Pokemon Silenzio
Quando ci si imbatte in un bosco all'apparenza desolato, meglio fare attenzione: potrebbe trattarsi del territorio di un Hatterene.
pt: Silent Pokemon
Beware of forests that show no signs of living creatures within. You may have wandered into Hatterene's territory.

es: Pokemon Astuto
Forman manadas en las cuales se hacen rabiar los unos a los otros a base de trastadas para pulir sus desvergonzadas habilidades.
en: Wily Pokemon
They live in groups, pestering and playing pranks on each other to polish their troublemaking skills.
fr: Pokemon Malin
Ils vivent en groupe et se jouent mutuellement de mauvais tours afin d'affuter leurs esprits facetieux.
de: Hinterlist-Pokemon
Baehmon leben in Gruppen, innerhalb derer sie sich gegenseitig Streiche spielen und einander aergern. So werden sie immer besser darin.
it: Pokemon Scaltro
Vivono in gruppi. Si fanno dispetti e cattiverie a vicenda per affinare la propria abilita nel creare problemi.
pt: Wily Pokemon
They live in groups, pestering and playing pranks on each other to polish their troublemaking skills.

es: Pokemon Malicioso
Este Pokemon absorbe los sentimientos negativos y los transforma en energia. Es popular entre los pesimistas.
en: Devious Pokemon
This Pokemon absorbs negative emotions and turns them into energy. It's popular with people who tend to think gloomy thoughts.
fr: Pokemon Scelerat
Ce Pokemon absorbe les sentiments negatifs et y puise son energie. Il est donc tres populaire aupres des pessimistes.
de: Schelm-Pokemon
Es absorbiert negative Gefuehle und wandelt sie in Energie um. Bei Pessimisten ist es sehr beliebt.
it: Pokemon Furbizia
Assorbe sentimenti negativi, trasformandoli in energia. E particolarmente apprezzato da chi ha un'indole pessimista.
pt: Devious Pokemon
This Pokemon absorbs negative emotions and turns them into energy. It's popular with people who tend to think gloomy thoughts.

es: Pokemon Voluminoso
Vive en lo mas profundo del bosque. A pesar de haber evolucionado, no abandona las pequenas bromas y las trastadas.
en: Bulk Up Pokemon
It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving into this splendid form, it hasn't given up on its petty misdeeds and pranks.
fr: Pokemon Gonflette
Il vit au fin fond des forets. Il a beau avoir evolue en une creature majestueuse, il continue a faire des farces et a jouer de mauvais tours.
de: Muskelaufbau-Pokemon
Es ist in den Tiefen von Waeldern zu Hause. Trotz seiner stattlichen Entwicklung hoert es nicht auf, Schabernack zu treiben.
it: Pokemon Granfisico
Vive nelle profondita dei boschi. Per quanto si sia evoluto in questa splendida forma, non ha perso il vizio di fare dispetti e cattiverie.
pt: Bulk Up Pokemon
It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving into this splendid form, it hasn't given up on its petty misdeeds and pranks.

es: Pokemon Bloqueador
Evoluciona tras haber librado numerosas peleas. El grito de guerra que profiere mientras pone los brazos en cruz atemoriza a cualquier rival.
en: Blocking Pokemon
It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
fr: Pokemon Barrage
Il a evolue apres avoir enchaine de nombreux combats. Le cri qu'il pousse lorsqu'il fait un X avec ses bras ebranle n'importe quel ennemi.
de: Barrikaden-Pokemon
Durch das Austragen unzaehliger Kaempfe hat es sich entwickelt. Formt es mit den Armen ein X" und stoesst einen Schrei aus, verschreckt das jeden.
it: Pokemon Bloccaggio
Si e evoluto a forza di lottare. L'urlo di guerra che lancia mentre mette le braccia a X e in grado di terrorizzare qualsiasi avversario.
pt: Blocking Pokemon
It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

es: Pokemon Vikingo
Su devocion por la lucha ha propiciado que evolucionara y le ha conferido unas peligrosas garras que se convierten en dagas al extenderse.
en: Viking Pokemon
After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
fr: Pokemon Viking
Il s'est tant adonne au combat qu'il a evolue : il est desormais dote de griffes redoutables qui prennent la forme de dagues en s'allongeant.
de: Wikinger-Pokemon
Es entwickelte sich nach einer langen Zeit voller Kaempfe. Nun kann es seine Krallen ausfahren, um sie als Dolche zu nutzen.
it: Pokemon Vichingo
Si e evoluto dopo aver passato giorni interi a lottare e ha sviluppato degli artigli che, una volta sfoderati, diventano temibili pugnali.
pt: Viking Pokemon
After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

es: Pokemon Coral
Conviene tener cuidado con el cuerpo espectral que recubre su alma, pues quien lo toque podria acabar inerte como una piedra.
en: Coral Pokemon
Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
fr: Pokemon Corail
Ceux qui ont le malheur de toucher le corps spirituel qui protege son noyau se retrouveront immobilises, comme changes en pierre.
de: Korallen-Pokemon
Vor dem geisterhaften Ektoplasma, das seine Seele umhuellt, ist Vorsicht geboten. Beruehrt man es, erstarrt man wie zu Stein.
it: Pokemon Corallo
Il corpo di ectoplasma che avvolge la sua anima e pericolosissimo: chi lo tocca si immobilizza come se fosse stato tramutato in pietra.
pt: Coral Pokemon
Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

es: Pokemon Pato Salvaje
Repele ataques con las hojas de su duro puerro y contraataca con su tallo afilado. El puerro que le sirve de armamento sigue siendo comestible.
en: Wild Duck Pokemon
After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
fr: Pokemon Canard Fou
Il pare les attaques avec le tranchant de son solide poireau, et contre-attaque avec la pointe de la tige. Son arme est egalement comestible.
de: Wildenten-Pokemon
Der Lauch dient ihm als Waffe und zur Abwehr, aber viele essen ihn auch. Mit den harten Blaettern pariert es und mit der scharfen Stange kontert es.
it: Pokemon Selvanatra
Devia gli attacchi usando la dura foglia del porro e contrattacca con il gambo affilato. Usa il porro sia come arma che come cibo.
pt: Wild Duck Pokemon
After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

es: Pokemon Comico
Se ha granjeado la simpatia de todo el mundo por sus comicos movimientos. Emite poderes psiquicos por el motivo de su barriga.
en: Comedian Pokemon
Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
fr: Pokemon Comedien
Ses gestes hilarants le rendent tres populaire. Il peut liberer ses pouvoirs psychiques depuis le motif sur son ventre.
de: Komiker-Pokemon
Dank seiner unterhaltsamen Bewegungen ist es allseits sehr beliebt. Von dem Muster auf seinem Bauch sendet es Psycho-Kraefte aus.
it: Pokemon Comico
Le sue comiche movenze lo rendono simpatico a tutti. Emette poteri psichici dal motivo che ha sul ventre.
pt: Comedian Pokemon
Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

es: Pokemon Resquemor
Su cuerpo, similar a una sombra, no debe tocarse bajo ningun concepto o se visualizaran los horribles recuerdos impregnados en la imagen.
en: Grudge Pokemon
Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
fr: Pokemon Rancune
Quiconque touchera son corps semblable a une ombre devra endurer la vision des souvenirs effroyables graves dans ses motifs.
de: Gram-Pokemon
Man sollte seinen schattenhaften Koerper nicht beruehren, sonst zeigt es einem die schauerlichen Erinnerungen, die in sein Bild eingraviert wurden.
it: Pokemon Rancore
Non bisogna toccare il suo corpo simile a un'ombra, o si vedranno i propri ricordi piu terribili imprigionati nel suo motivo.
pt: Grudge Pokemon
Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

es: Pokemon Nata
Si recibe un ataque, carga contra su rival y huye, ya sea gracias a haberlo cegado al recubrirlo de nata o a haberlo abrumado con su suculencia.
en: Cream Pokemon
When attacked, it tackles its foe and covers them in cream. With its foe either blinded or astonished by deliciousness, Milcery flees.
fr: Pokemon Creme
Si on l'attaque, il charge l'adversaire et s'enfuit apres l'avoir recouvert de creme pour l'aveugler ou pour le surprendre avec sa saveur delicieuse.
de: Sahne-Pokemon
Wenn es angegriffen wird, stuerzt es sich auf den Feind. Ist dieser blind vor lauter Sahne oder verbluefft vom leckeren Geschmack, flieht es.
it: Pokemon Pannafresca
Se un nemico lo attacca, gli si lancia contro e lo cosparge di panna per impedirgli di vedere o lo sorprende con la sua bonta. Poi, scappa via.
pt: Cream Pokemon
When attacked, it tackles its foe and covers them in cream. With its foe either blinded or astonished by deliciousness, Milcery flees.

es: Pokemon Nata
La nata que producen los Alcremie tratados con carino es un manjar tan exquisito que todos sus Entrenadores los colman de atenciones.
en: Cream Pokemon
Alcremie that have been cherished produce exquisite cream, so Trainers always raise them lovingly.
fr: Pokemon Creme
Les Charmilly produisent une creme exquise lorsqu'ils sont choyes. C'est pourquoi ils sont eleves avec beaucoup de douceur.
de: Sahne-Pokemon
Pokusan, die gut behandelt werden, produzieren besonders leckere Sahne. Trainer kuemmern sich daher immer sehr liebevoll um diese Pokemon.
it: Pokemon Pannafresca
La panna prodotta da un Alcremie trattato con riguardo e una vera prelibatezza, quindi tutti gli Allenatori sono amorevoli con loro.
pt: Cream Pokemon
Alcremie that have been cherished produce exquisite cream, so Trainers always raise them lovingly.

es: Pokemon Formacion
Este Pokemon consta de cinco subalternos y un lider, cuyas ordenes obedecen sin rechistar.
en: Formation Pokemon
Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.
fr: Pokemon Escadron
C'est une entite unique composee d'un chef et de cinq subordonnes. Ces derniers obeissent sans sourciller a leur superieur hierarchique.
de: Formations-Pokemon
Dieses Pokemon besteht aus fuenf Untergebenen und einem Anfuehrer. Die Befehle des Anfuehrers werden nie in Frage gestellt.
it: Pokemon Schieramento
Questo Pokemon e formato da un capo e da cinque sottoposti che obbediscono ciecamente ai suoi ordini.
pt: Formation Pokemon
Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

es: Pokemon Erizo de Mar
Es tan cobarde que le basta con rozar un alga a la deriva para asustarse y liberar descargas. Sus labios no conducen la electricidad.
en: Sea Urchin Pokemon
This Pokemon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.
fr: Pokemon Oursin
Il est si peureux que s'il effleure des algues, cela le surprend et il libere une decharge. Ses levres ne conduisent pas l'electricite.
de: Seeigel-Pokemon
Es ist so furchtsam, dass es schon durch die blosse Beruehrung mit einer Alge vor Schreck Strom entlaedt. Seine Lippen leiten keine Elektrizitaet.
it: Pokemon Echino
E talmente fifone che gli basta sfiorare un'alga per emettere scariche elettriche dallo spavento. Le sue labbra non conducono elettricita.
pt: Sea Urchin Pokemon
This Pokemon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.

es: Pokemon Gusano
Amplifica en sus organos internos el frio que consigue al comer nieve y lo usa para crear sus puas como carambanos.
en: Worm Pokemon
Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.
fr: Pokemon Ver
Il amplifie l'air froid qu'il absorbe en mangeant de la neige, ce qui lui permet de creer ses pointes semblables a des pics de glace.
de: Wurm-Pokemon
Mit den inneren Organen verstaerkt es die Kaelte, die es mit dem Schnee aufnimmt. Dadurch kann es Stacheln formen, die wie Eiszapfen aussehen.
it: Pokemon Baco
Mangiando neve immagazzina aria gelida, poi ne amplifica l'effetto tramite gli organi interni per creare gli aculei di ghiaccio che ha sul dorso.
pt: Worm Pokemon
Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

es: Pokemon Polillahielo
Cuando revolotea, provoca ventiscas con sus enormes alas que liberan frio. Le encanta el agua limpia del deshielo.
en: Frost Moth Pokemon
It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.
fr: Pokemon Mite Givre
Ce Pokemon provoque des blizzards en battant de ses grandes ailes, qui degagent de l'air froid. Il aime l'eau pure de la neige fraichement fondue.
de: Eismotten-Pokemon
Seine grossen Fluegel setzen beim Fliegen eine Eiseskaelte frei, wodurch es Schneestuerme ausloest. Klares Schmelzwasser trinkt es besonders gern.
it: Pokemon Gelofalena
Vola generando con le grandi ali delle correnti gelide che causano tempeste di neve. Adora dissetarsi d'acqua limpida del disgelo.
pt: Frost Moth Pokemon
It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

es: Pokemon Megalito
Pasa el dia observando el recorrido del sol. Se pasea con tranquilidad por las praderas con sus rocosas patas de mas de 200 kg.
en: Big Rock Pokemon
This Pokemon spends its life gazing at the setting sun. It strides leisurely across grassy plains on legs of rock that weigh over 400 pounds each.
fr: Pokemon Megalithe
Il passe son temps a suivre le parcours du soleil dans le ciel et arpente tranquillement les plaines avec ses jambes rocheuses de plus de 200 kg.
de: Megalithen-Pokemon
Es verbringt sein Leben damit, Sonnenuntergaenge zu beobachten und mit seinen 200 kg schweren Beinen aus Stein ueber Wiesen zu spazieren.
it: Pokemon Megalito
Trascorre le giornate osservando il passaggio del sole. Con le gambe rocciose pesanti piu di 200 kg percorre calmo e maestoso le praterie.
pt: Big Rock Pokemon
This Pokemon spends its life gazing at the setting sun. It strides leisurely across grassy plains on legs of rock that weigh over 400 pounds each.

es: Pokemon Pinguino
El hielo que le recubre la cara es ligeramente salado. Llego desde unas lejanas tierras gelidas transportado por las corrientes marinas.
en: Penguin Pokemon
If you lick the ice covering its face, you'll find it has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.
fr: Pokemon Pingouin
Originaire de terres lointaines et froides, il a voyage jusqu'ici grace aux courants marins. La glace sur sa tete est legerement salee.
de: Pinguin-Pokemon
Das Eis um seinen Kopf schmeckt leicht salzig. Mithilfe von Meeresstroemungen ist es aus einer weit entfernten, kalten Region hergekommen.
it: Pokemon Pinguino
Il ghiaccio della testa ha un gusto leggermente salato. E giunto da una lontana terra gelida trasportato dalle correnti marine.
pt: Penguin Pokemon
If you lick the ice covering its face, you'll find it has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.

es: Pokemon Sensorio
Siempre permanece junto a su Entrenador. Usa sus poderes psiquicos para predecir su conducta y atiende todas sus necesidades.
en: Emotion Pokemon
This Pokemon never leaves its Trainer's side. It predicts their actions with its psychic power and takes care of their day-to-day needs.
fr: Pokemon Emotion
Wimessir reste toujours pres de son Dresseur. Grace a ses pouvoirs psychiques, il peut predire ses actions et ainsi prendre soin de lui.
de: Emotions-Pokemon
Es haelt sich stets an der Seite seines Trainers auf und nutzt Psycho-Kraefte, um dessen Handlungen zu erahnen und sich um ihn kuemmern zu koennen.
it: Pokemon Emozione
Resta sempre al fianco del proprio Allenatore. Usa i poteri psichici per prevederne le azioni e per prendersene cura.
pt: Emotion Pokemon
This Pokemon never leaves its Trainer's side. It predicts their actions with its psychic power and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

es: Pokemon Dos Caras
Debido al pequeno tamano de su estomago, si no come constantemente las semillas que guarda en los bolsillos, le entra hambre de inmediato.
en: Two-Sided Pokemon
It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.
fr: Pokemon Volt Face
S'il ne mange pas constamment les graines qu'il emmagasine dans ses poches, son petit estomac se vide et il a immediatement faim.
de: Alter Ego-Pokemon
Da sein Magen klein ist, wird es sofort hungrig, wenn es nicht staendig die Samen aus seinen Taschen frisst.
it: Pokemon Doppiafaccia
Dato che ha uno stomaco piccolo, deve mangiare costantemente i semi che tiene nelle tasche, altrimenti gli viene subito fame.
pt: Two-Sided Pokemon
It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

es: Pokemon Broncefante
Puede levantar cargas de cinco toneladas. Al amanecer, se dirigen en manada a las cuevas en busca de los minerales de los que se alimentan.
en: Copperderm Pokemon
Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokemon feed.
fr: Pokemon Pachycuivre
Il peut soulever des charges de cinq tonnes. Le matin, il se rend dans les grottes avec son troupeau, en quete du minerai dont il se nourrit.
de: Kupferfant-Pokemon
Kupfanti kann ein Gewicht von 5 t stemmen. Morgens macht es sich mit seiner Herde auf den Weg zu Hoehlen, wo es Erz zum Fressen sucht.
it: Pokemon Bronzofante
Puo sollevare carichi di cinque tonnellate. Al mattino si dirige in gruppo con i suoi simili verso le grotte, in cerca dei minerali di cui si nutre.
pt: Copperderm Pokemon
Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokemon feed.

es: Pokemon Broncefante
Es orgulloso y dificil de tratar. Aquellos con un tono de piel verde mas vivo se ganan el respeto de sus congeneres.
en: Copperderm Pokemon
Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokemon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.
fr: Pokemon Pachycuivre
Ce Pokemon tres fier a plutot mauvais caractere. Le vert eclatant de sa peau lui vaut le respect de ses congeneres.
de: Kupferfant-Pokemon
Es ist sehr stolz und muerrisch. Exemplare mit leuchtend gruener Haut werden von ihren Artgenossen besonders stark respektiert.
it: Pokemon Bronzofante
Ha un'indole orgogliosa e stizzosa. I Copperajah con la pelle di colore verde acceso sono riveriti dai propri simili.
pt: Copperderm Pokemon
Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokemon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

es: Pokemon Fosil
Produce electricidad con la robusta musculatura de la cola. El tamano de la parte superior del cuerpo palidece en comparacion con la inferior.
en: Fossil Pokemon
The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.
fr: Pokemon Fossile
Il envoie des decharges avec les muscles puissants de sa queue. La partie superieure de son corps est trop petite par rapport a la partie inferieure.
de: Fossil-Pokemon
Mit den kraeftigen Muskeln in seinem Schwanz erzeugt es Elektrizitaet. Sein Oberkoerper ist im Vergleich zu seinem Unterkoerper zu klein.
it: Pokemon Fossile
Produce elettricita con i possenti muscoli della coda. La parte superiore del suo corpo e troppo piccola se paragonata a quella inferiore.
pt: Fossil Pokemon
The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

es: Pokemon Fosil
Antiguamente vivia en el mar y usaba el hielo del cuerpo para conservar los alimentos. Su extrema lentitud, sin embargo, lo condeno a la extincion.
en: Fossil Pokemon
This Pokemon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
fr: Pokemon Fossile
Autrefois, il vivait en bord de mer et conservait sa nourriture dans la glace de son corps, mais il s'est eteint, car il avait du mal a se deplacer.
de: Fossil-Pokemon
In der Urzeit lebte es am Strand und konnte mit seinem kalten Koerper Futter haltbar machen. Es starb wegen seiner traegen Bewegungen aus.
it: Pokemon Fossile
Anticamente viveva in riva al mare conservando il cibo grazie al ghiaccio del suo corpo, ma si e estinto a causa della sua estrema lentezza.
pt: Fossil Pokemon
This Pokemon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

es: Pokemon Fosil
Exhibe con orgullo su inmensa capacidad motriz, que le permite superar los 60 km/h, pero solo puede respirar bajo el agua.
en: Fossil Pokemon
Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokemon can't breathe unless it's underwater.
fr: Pokemon Fossile
Ses pattes robustes lui permettent de courir a plus de 60 km/h, mais en revanche, il ne peut respirer que sous l'eau.
de: Fossil-Pokemon
Seine aussergewoehnlich kraeftigen Beine lassen es zwar ueber 60 km/h schnell laufen, doch atmen kann es nur unter Wasser.
it: Pokemon Fossile
Vanta gambe molto potenti che gli permettono di correre a una velocita superiore a 60 km/h, ma puo respirare solo sott'acqua.
pt: Fossil Pokemon
Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokemon can't breathe unless it's underwater.

es: Pokemon Fosil
Aunque la piel de su rostro era capaz de resistir cualquier ataque, su dificultad para respirar acabo provocando su extincion.
en: Fossil Pokemon
The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokemon go extinct anyway.
fr: Pokemon Fossile
Aucune attaque ne pouvait egratigner la peau de son visage, mais il s'est eteint, car il avait du mal a respirer.
de: Fossil-Pokemon
Kein Angriff konnte seine Gesichtshaut verletzen, doch es war in seiner Atmung eingeschraenkt und starb daher aus.
it: Pokemon Fossile
Nessun attacco poteva scalfire la pelle del suo muso, ma si e estinto perche aveva difficolta a respirare.
pt: Fossil Pokemon
The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokemon go extinct anyway.

es: Pokemon Aleacion
Su cuerpo metalico es robusto, pero acumula calor con tanta facilidad que se ve obligado a liberarlo a traves de las rendijas de la cola.
en: Alloy Pokemon
Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.
fr: Pokemon Alliage
Ce Pokemon a un corps en metal robuste, mais comme la chaleur reste piegee a l'interieur, il doit la liberer par les fentes de sa queue.
de: Legierungs-Pokemon
Sein metallener Koerper ist robust, aber heizt sich schnell auf. Um einen Hitzestau zu verhindern, leitet es Waerme durch Schlitze im Schwanz ab.
it: Pokemon Metallolega
Il suo corpo metallico e robusto ma ha lo svantaggio di accumulare calore, che viene percio rilasciato dalle fessure sulla coda.
pt: Alloy Pokemon
Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.

es: Pokemon Resentido
Se lanza a morder a los Clauncher a pesar de no alimentarse de ellos. Se dice que este habito es un vestigio de cuando estaba vivo.
en: Lingering Pokemon
It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.
fr: Pokemon Ame Errante
Il a tendance a croquer les Flingouste, alors qu'il ne s'en nourrit pas. Cette habitude serait un vestige de sa vie passee, lorsqu'il etait bien vivant.
de: Missgunst-Pokemon
Es beisst sich oft an Scampisto fest, ohne dieses zu fressen. Das haelt man fuer eine Angewohnheit aus einer Zeit, als Grolldra noch am Leben war.
it: Pokemon Risentimento
Morde i Clauncher, nonostante non facciano parte della sua dieta. Pare che questa abitudine sia un retaggio di quando era in vita.
pt: Lingering Pokemon
It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

es: Pokemon Cuidador
Almacena en los pulmones energia que luego expulsa. Lucha junto a un Dreepy y cuida de el hasta que alcanza la madurez.
en: Caretaker Pokemon
This Pokemon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.
fr: Pokemon Baby-sitter
Il accumule de l'energie dans ses poumons puis l'expulse. Il prend soin de son Fantyrm et se bat a ses cotes jusqu'a ce qu'il grandisse.
de: Betreuer-Pokemon
In der Lunge sammelt es Energie, die es dann abschiesst. Es kuemmert sich so lange um Grolldra, bis dieses ausgewachsen ist.
it: Pokemon Sostegno
Accumula energia nei polmoni per poi spararla fuori. Lotta assieme a Dreepy e se ne prende cura finche questo non raggiunge la maturita.
pt: Caretaker Pokemon
This Pokemon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.

es: Pokemon Furtivo
El mas veloz de la manada siempre esta rodeado de Dreepy deseosos de volar a velocidades supersonicas.
en: Stealth Pokemon
The fastest Dragapult of the group is always surrounded by Dreepy that want to fly at sonic speed.

Le specimen le plus rapide d'un groupe de Lanssorien est toujours entoure de Fantyrm desireux de se deplacer a la vitesse du son.

Das schnellste Exemplar einer Gruppe ist immer von Grolldra umgeben, die darauf aus sind, mit Schallgeschwindigkeit zu fliegen.
it: Pokemon Furtivo
Il piu rapido del gruppo e costantemente attorniato da Dreepy desiderosi di essere sparati via alla velocita del suono.
pt: Stealth Pokemon
The fastest Dragapult of the group is always surrounded by Dreepy that want to fly at sonic speed.

es: Pokemon Guerrero
Hay quien lo considera una suerte de figura fraterna a la par que rival de Zamazenta, un Pokemon sumido en un profundo letargo.

This Pokemon has slumbered for many years. Some say it's Zamazenta's elder sister-others say the two Pokemon are rivals.
fr: Pokemon Valeureux
On dit qu'il s'agit de la figure fraternelle et du rival de Zamazenta, un Pokemon plonge dans un long sommeil.
de: Krieger-Pokemon
Man sagt, es sei wie ein aelteres Geschwisterteil, aber auch wie ein Rivale zu Zamazenta, welches in einen langen Schlaf gefallen war.
it: Pokemon Guerriero
Viene considerato una figura fraterna e allo stesso tempo un rivale per Zamazenta, un Pokemon rimasto a lungo addormentato.
pt: Warrior Pokemon
This Pokemon has slumbered for many years. Some say it's Zamazenta's elder sister-others say the two Pokemon are rivals.

es: Pokemon Guerrero
Con la apariencia de una estatua de piedra, este Pokemon se sumio en un letargo tan profundo que acabo cayendo en el olvido.
en: Warrior Pokemon
This Pokemon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
fr: Pokemon Valeureux
Ce Pokemon, change en statue, est reste petrifie si longtemps qu'il a failli tomber dans l'oubli.
de: Krieger-Pokemon
Dieses Pokemon fiel in Form einer Steinstatue in solch einen langen Schlaf, dass es in Vergessenheit geraten ist.
it: Pokemon Guerriero
Questo Pokemon e rimasto addormentato sotto forma di statua cosi a lungo da venire completamente dimenticato.
pt: Warrior Pokemon
This Pokemon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

es: Pokemon Gigantesco
Fue hallado en el interior de un meteorito caido hace 20 000 anos. Por lo visto, esta relacionado con el misterio que rodea al fenomeno Dinamax.
en: Gigantic Pokemon
It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokemon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

Il se trouvait dans une meteorite qui s'est ecrasee il y a 20 000 ans. Il semble y avoir un lien entre ce Pokemon et le phenomene Dynamax.

Es steckte in einem Meteorit, der vor 20 000 Jahren herabstuerzte. Es scheint in Verbindung mit dem Dynamax-Phaenomen zu stehen.
it: Pokemon Gigante
E giunto dallo spazio dentro un meteorite caduto 20.000 anni fa. Sembra essere in qualche modo collegato al mistero del fenomeno Dynamax.
pt: Gigantic Pokemon
It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokemon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

es: Pokemon Kung-fu
Al tirar de los mechones blancos de la cabeza, acrecienta su espiritu luchador y empieza a acumular fuerza en el organo de su bajo vientre.
en: Wushu Pokemon
If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
fr: Pokemon Kung-fu
Lorsqu'il tire sur les longs poils blancs sur sa tete, il devient plus combatif et de l'energie jaillit de sous son nombril.
de: Kung-Fu-Pokemon
Zieht es an dem langen weissen Fell an seinem Hinterkopf, steigert das seinen Kampfgeist und aus seiner Koerpermitte steigt Kraft empor.
it: Pokemon Kung Fu
Tira i lunghi ciuffi di pelo bianco che ha sulla testa per incrementare il suo spirito combattivo, facendo sgorgare energia dal ventre.
pt: Wushu Pokemon
If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

es: Pokemon Kung-fu
Vive en zonas montanosas en areas reconditas, donde entrena corriendo por escarpados riscos para fortalecer sus piernas y refinar su tecnica.
en: Wushu Pokemon
Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokemon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
fr: Pokemon Kung-fu
Il vit dans une lointaine region montagneuse ou il peaufine ses techniques et muscle ses jambes en courant le long des falaises abruptes.
de: Kung-Fu-Pokemon
Wulaosu lebt in den Bergen einer fernen Region. Um die Beine zu staehlen und seine Kampftechnik zu verbessern, rennt es steile Klippen entlang.

Vive nelle zone montuose di una regione lontana. Corre sulle pareti dei dirupi, allenando gli arti inferiori e perfezionando le sue mosse.
pt: Wushu Pokemon
Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokemon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

es: Pokemon Simiestro
Las lianas que le brotan del cuerpo nutren y fertilizan el mantillo del bosque cuando se le desprenden.

Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
fr: Pokemon Vilain Singe
Lorsque ses lianes se detachent de son corps, elles fertilisent le sol et favorisent la croissance des plantes de la foret.

Reissen die an seinem Koerper wachsenden Ranken ab, werden sie zu Naehrstoffen fuer den Boden, was den Pflanzen im Wald zum Wachstum verhilft.

Se si staccano, le liane del suo corpo diventano nutrimento per il suolo, favorendo lo sviluppo delle piante della foresta.

es: Pokemon Electron
Todo su cuerpo es un organo electrogeno, cuya potencia seria suficiente para abastecer la region de Galar por completo.

Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.
fr: Pokemon Electron
Son corps est entierement compose d'organes generant de l'electricite. Il peut produire assez d'energie pour alimenter tout Galar.

Sein Koerper besteht aus einem Organ, das elektrische Energie erzeugt. Regieleki kann genug Strom produzieren, um ganz Galar zu versorgen.

Il suo corpo e costituito interamente da un organo che produce energia elettrica. Fornisce corrente all'intera regione di Galar.

Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.

es: Pokemon Dragosfera
Todo su cuerpo es una gema de energia dragon cristalizada. Se cree que posee los poderes de todos los Pokemon dragon.
en: Dragon Orb Pokemon
Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokemon.
fr: Pokemon Boule Dragon
Son corps est entierement compose de cristaux d'energie draconique. Il possederait les pouvoirs de tous les Pokemon Dragon.
de: Drachenkugel-Pokemon
Sein ganzer Koerper besteht aus kristallisierter Drachen-Energie. Es soll ueber die Kraefte aller Drachen-Pokemon verfuegen.

Il suo corpo e formato da energia Drago cristallizzata. Pare che possieda i poteri di tutti i Pokemon di tipo Drago.
pt: Dragon Orb Pokemon
Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokemon.

es: Pokemon Corcel Feroz
Cuenta con una fuerza fisica sobrecogedora. La mascara de hielo que le cubre el rostro es cien veces mas dura que el diamante.
en: Wild Horse Pokemon
Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

Ce Pokemon a la force hors du commun porte un masque compose de glace cent fois plus solide que le diamant.

Das Gesicht dieses aussergewoehnlich starken Pokemon wird von einer Maske aus Eis bedeckt, die hundertmal haerter als Diamant ist.

E dotato di una forza incommensurabile. La maschera di ghiaccio che gli ricopre il muso e cento volte piu dura del diamante.
pt: Wild Horse Pokemon

es: Pokemon Corcel Veloz
Amante de la quietud y la soledad, galopa por las tinieblas nocturnas absorbiendo la energia vital de toda criatura que este durmiendo.
en: Swift Horse Pokemon
As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
fr: Pokemon Cheval Vif
Ce Pokemon friand de silence et de solitude galope a travers les tenebres nocturnes et aspire l'energie vitale des etres endormis.

Es galoppiert durch die finstere Nacht und absorbiert die Lebensenergie der Schlafenden. Phantoross bevorzugt Einsamkeit und Stille.

Galoppa nelle notti buie assorbendo l'energia vitale delle creature addormentate. Ama la solitudine e la quiete.
pt: Swift Horse Pokemon
As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

es: Pokemon Rey
Legendario monarca del antiguo Galar. Posee el poder de sanar el espiritu y de hacer brotar la vegetacion.
en: King Pokemon
Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
fr: Pokemon Roi
Ce roi legendaire qui a regne sur Galar il y a fort longtemps possede le pouvoir d'apaiser les coeurs et de faire germer les plantes.

Ein legendaerer Koenig, der einst Galar regierte. Coronospa besitzt die Macht, Herzen zu besaenftigen und Pflanzen gedeihen zu lassen.

Il re delle leggende che domino su Galar in un lontano passato. E in grado di calmare gli animi e far germogliare la vegetazione.
pt: King Pokemon
Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

es: Pokemon Gran Cuerno
Sus orbes negros brillan con un fulgor misterioso cuando erige muros invisibles. El pelaje que se desprende de sus barbas es muy codiciado para crear calidos ropajes para el invierno.
en: Big Horn Pokemon
The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokemon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
fr: Pokemon Maxi Corne
Ses boules noires emettent une inquietante lueur lorsqu'il erige des barrieres invisibles. Les poils de barbe qu'il perd servent a confectionner des vetements d'hiver bien chauds.
de: Vielender-Pokemon
Die schwarzen Kugeln leuchten auf ominoese Weise, wenn es unsichtbare Waende erschafft. Das Barthaar, das es verliert, wird als Material fuer warme Winterkleidung hoch geschaetzt.
it: Pokemon Grancorno
Quando si accinge a creare pareti invisibili, le sue atre sfere rifulgono di luce sinistra. I crini caduti dalla barba vengon adoprati per confezionare caldi abiti invernali.
pt: Big Horn Pokemon
The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokemon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

es: Pokemon Hacha
Un Pokemon violento, tosco y rudo. Blande sus enormes y pesadas hachas de piedra para acabar con sus presas.

This Pokemon is a rough, crude, and violent sort. It swings around its large, heavy stone axes to finish off its prey.
fr: Pokemon Hache
Ce Pokemon rustre et violent elimine ses proies en faisant furieusement tournoyer ses grandes et lourdes haches de pierre.

Dieses grobe, ungehobelte und aggressive Pokemon wirbelt wild mit seinen wuchtigen Aexten aus Stein, um Beute niederzustrecken.

Di indole violenta, rozza e brutale. Abbatte la preda mulinando le grosse e pesanti asce di pietra.

es: Pokemon Turba
Este Ursaluna tan particular se protege el cuerpo con una capa de barro tan dura como el hierro. Su ojo izquierdo le permite ver en la oscuridad.

This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.
fr: Pokemon Tourbe
Cet Ursaking singulier peut voir dans l'obscurite grace a son oeil gauche. De la boue aussi dure que le fer protege son corps.

Dieses besondere Ursaluna schuetzt seinen Koerper mit Schlamm, der mit der Zeit stahlhart wurde. Sein linkes Auge kann selbst im Dunkeln sehen.

Questo insolito Ursaluna protegge il corpo con del fango indurito, robusto come ferro. Il suo occhio sinistro e in grado di vedere nell'oscurita.
pt: Peat Pokemon

es: Pokemon Gran Pez
Su capacidad de salto es asombrosa. La ira de sus camaradas caidos le confiere un tono rojizo a su cuerpo.

It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen friends.
fr: Pokemon Poissigrand
Ce Pokemon peut faire des bonds vertigineux. La colere de ses defunts congeneres a donne a son corps une teinte rouge.

Es verfuegt ueber eine nahezu unheimliche Sprungkraft. Der Zorn von verstorbenen Artgenossen faerbt seinen Koerper rot.

Possiede un'incredibile potenza di salto. L'ira dei suoi compagni morti conferisce al suo corpo una colorazione rossa.
pt: Big Fish Pokemon

es: Pokemon Escalada
Gracias a su fortaleza fisica y potente veneno, ninguna especie de las alturas heladas le planta cara. Es de personalidad solitaria y no forma manadas.
en: Free Climb Pokemon
Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
fr: Pokemon Grimpeur
Ce Pokemon n'a guere d'ennemis sur les hauteurs froidies, car ses aptitudes physiques sont sans egales et son poison est mortel. Il prefere la solitude a la vie en groupe.
de: Kletterei-Pokemon
Im frostigen Hochland kann diesem Einzelgaenger kein anderes Pokemon das Wasser reichen, da er neben hochwirksamem Gift ueber herausragende koerperliche Faehigkeiten verfuegt.
it: Pokemon Scalata
Nei frigidi altipiani non ha pari grazie al veleno che produce e a capacita fisiche che nessun'altra specie puo eguagliare. Non vive in branco e ben sopporta la solitudine.
pt: Free Climb Pokemon
Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

es: Pokemon Espinoso
Posee un caracter feroz y agresivo. Las puntas de sus puas venenosas son dentadas, por lo que no resulta facil extraerlas una vez que se clavan.

It's ferocious and has a short temper. The ends of its spikes are barbed, and they can't be easily removed once they've punctured something.

Ce Pokemon est feroce et impulsif. Ses epines empoisonnees ont des extremites dentelees. Une fois plantees, elles sont difficiles a retirer.

Es ist ungestuem und brutal. Die Spitzen seiner Giftstacheln sind gezackt, wodurch sie sich nach einem Stich nur schwer entfernen lassen.

Ha un carattere feroce e violento. Le punte seghettate dei suoi aculei velenosi rendono difficile estrarli una volta conficcati.

es: Pokemon Amorodio
Su llegada de allende el mar significa el fin del duro invierno. De acuerdo con el folclore, su amor siempre trae consigo un soplo de vida nueva a Hisui.
en: Love-Hate Pokemon
When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokemon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

Son arrivee par les mers annonce la fin des hivers rigoureux. On raconte que c'est l'amour que ce Pokemon ressent qui fait bourgeonner de nouvelles vies dans la region de Hisui.

Kommt es uebers Meer geflogen, neigt sich der harsche Winter dem Ende zu. Der Volksmund sagt, dass dank seiner Liebe neues Leben in Hisui Knospen treibe.
it: Pokemon Amoreodio
La sua venuta dai cieli al di la del mare annunzia la fine del rigido inverno. Si narra che il suo amore faccia germogliare nuova vita a Hisui.
pt: Love-Hate Pokemon
When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokemon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

es: Pokemon Gato Planta
Su cuerpo desprende una dulce fragancia que embriaga a quien tiene a su alrededor. Esta se intensifica al exponerse a los rayos del sol.

The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokemon is in the sun.
fr: Chat Plante
Il degage une odeur sucree qui fascine les etres alentour. Celle-ci est plus forte lorsqu'il est expose au soleil.
de: Florakatze
Es verzaubert alle in seiner Umgebung mit dem suessen Duft, der von ihm ausgeht. Dieser wird durch Sonnenschein noch intensiver.

Il dolce profumo che emana dal corpo incanta chiunque si trovi nelle vicinanze e si intensifica quando il Pokemon si espone al sole.

La dureza de su pelaje cambia segun su estado de animo. Cuando se prepara para combatir, se vuelve duro y punzante como agujas.

The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokemon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

La rigidite de ses poils depend de son etat d'esprit. Quand il se prepare au combat, ceux-ci se herissent et sont aceres comme des aiguilles.
de: Florakatze
Die Geschmeidigkeit seines Fells aendert sich je nach Laune des Pokemon. Macht es sich fuer den Kampf bereit, wird das Fell so spitz wie Nadeln.
it: Pokemon Erbagatto
La durezza della pelliccia cambia in base al suo stato d'animo. Quando si accinge alla lotta, il suo pelo diventa irto di punte acuminate come aghi.
pt: Grass Cat Pokemon
The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokemon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

es: Pokemon Mago
Despues de desviar habilmente la atencion del oponente, le lanza sus bombas florales rellenas de polen y las hace estallar sin que se de cuenta.
en: Magician Pokemon
With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen- packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what's going on.
fr: Magicien
Il detourne habilement l'attention de ses ennemis et disperse subrepticement des bombes florales bourrees de pollen qu'il fait ensuite exploser.

Es lenkt seine Gegner geschickt ab, um ihnen unbemerkt Blumenbomben voller Pollen unterzuschieben, die es dann explodieren laesst.

Svia abilmente l'attenzione del nemico e, senza farsi notare, piazza bombe floreali cariche di polline che poi fa esplodere.

With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen- packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what's going on.

es: Pokemon Fuegodrilo
Como su saca de fuego es pequena, la energia ignea que rebosa se libera por la muesca de su cabeza en forma de una tremula llama.

Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.
fr: Croco Feu
Sa poche a flammes est trop petite pour contenir toute l'energie qu'il produit. Le surplus s'echappe en vacillant par la cavite sur sa tete.

Sein Flammensack ist noch klein, weshalb ueberquellende Energie ueber die Vertiefung an seinem Kopf flackernd freigesetzt wird.

La sua sacca ignea e piccola e l'energia trabocca, fuoriuscendo sotto forma di fiammelle tremule da una fessura sulla testa.

Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

es: Pokemon Fuegodrilo
Sus cuerdas vocales y la valvula de su saca de fuego estan estrechamente relacionadas. Emite sonidos guturales al expeler llamas.

The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokemon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

Ses cordes vocales et la valve de sa poche a flammes sont etroitement liees, ce qui lui permet de pousser des cris gutturaux en crachant du feu.

Das Ventil fuer seinen Flammensack ist eng mit den Stimmbaendern verbunden. Wenn es Feuer spuckt, stoesst es raue Laute aus.

Le sue corde vocali sono strettamente collegate alla valvola della sacca ignea. Mentre sputa fiammate tutt'intorno, emette versi rauchi.

The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokemon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

es: Pokemon Cantante
Su dulce canto calma el espiritu de quien lo oye. Achicharra a sus enemigos con llamas que llegan a alcanzar los 3000 oC.
en: Singer Pokemon
Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
fr: Chanteur
Il est capable de carboniser ses adversaires avec des flammes a 3 000 C. Sa voix douce possede des vertus apaisantes pour l'ame.

Sein sanfter Gesang beruhigt die Seelen all derer, die ihm lauschen. Feinde verbrennt es mit 3000 C heissen Flammen zu Asche.
it: Pokemon Cantante
Il suo dolce canto placa l'animo di chiunque lo ascolti. Riduce in cenere il nemico con fiamme che raggiungono i 3.000 oC.

es: Pokemon Patito
La fuerza de sus patas le permite nadar incluso por las mas fuertes corrientes fluviales. Adora la pulcritud y peca de inflexible en su actitud.
en: Duckling Pokemon
Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.
fr: Caneton
Ce Pokemon perfectionniste aime la proprete. Ses pattes puissantes lui permettent de nager avec aisance, meme lorsque le courant est fort.
de: Jungente
Seine Beine sind so kraeftig, dass es auch in Fluessen mit starker Stroemung frei schwimmen kann. Es ist ordnungsliebend und starrsinnig.
it: Pokemon Anatroccolo
Puo nuotare tranquillamente persino nei fiumi piu impetuosi grazie ai potenti arti inferiori. Tiene molto alla pulizia ed e incline a rimuginare.
pt: Duckling Pokemon
Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

es: Pokemon Disciplinado
Un Pokemon diligente que ha creado su propio estilo de danza tras observar los movimientos de humanos y Pokemon de varias regiones.
en: Practicing Pokemon
The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokemon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.
fr: Lecon
Tres diligent, il observe les mouvements de Pokemon et d'individus d'origines diverses pour s'en inspirer quand il danse.
de: Uebung
Dieses fleissige Pokemon beobachtet Menschen sowie Pokemon aus diversen Regionen und baut ihre Bewegungen in seine eigenen Taenze ein.
it: Pokemon Esercizio
Estremamente diligente, osserva le movenze di esseri umani e Pokemon di altre regioni per incorporarle nelle proprie danze.
pt: Practicing Pokemon
The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokemon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

es: Pokemon Bailarin
Embelesa a quien lo ve con una danza que rebosa de exotismo y corta a sus rivales con sus plumas ornamentales hechas de agua.
en: Dancer Pokemon
Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokemon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
fr: Danseur
Sa danse insolite est captivante. Il met ses adversaires en pieces a l'aide de ses plumes ornementales composees d'eau.
de: Taenzer
